question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description and the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous', where the total number of units is greater than 100, and only include subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such academic year, report the number of subjects that are classified as undergraduate (HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate'), and only include academic years where at least 60% of the subjects are undergraduate. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100 ), SubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects, COUNT(CASE WHEN ccso.HGN_DESC = 'Undergraduate' THEN 1 END) AS undergraduate_subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ic.total_units, sc.undergraduate_subjects, sc.total_subjects FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SubjectCounts sc ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = sc.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE sc.undergraduate_subjects > 0.6 * sc.total_subjects;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description and the subject code for subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) that have a total units value greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: From the top 10 IAP activities offered in the 2021 January term that are associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, display each activity's title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the subject title with the highest lecture units. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3 ) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.max_lecture_units, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap ON icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE AND at.TERM_DESCRIPTION = icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.LECTURE_UNITS = icte.max_lecture_units ORDER BY icte.max_lecture_units DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, as well as the school name and the total number of subjects in the department for that term. Do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the top 10 academic years by the number of subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department, also provide the start and end dates of each term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at.TERM_CODE = c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.num_subjects, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY i.num_subjects DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title and academic year of each course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, and also include the department name and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR

question: For each academic year and department, what is the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department, considering only subjects that are offered in the current term, have more than 0 total units, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Also, for each such group, what is the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term description group ordered by subject code, but only include those terms where at least 3 Mathematics subjects are offered in 2024. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), TermCounts AS ( SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte ic JOIN TermCounts tc ON ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION = tc.TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, but only include those subjects where the total units for the subject (from the course catalog) is at least 9. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year (for subjects offered in the fall term, with at least one TIP material, and in the Mathematics department), and what is the deviation of each year's average from the overall average number of TIP materials per subject across all such years? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH tip_counts AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ), per_year_stats AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(tc.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(tc.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(tc.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM tip_counts tc JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tc.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND tc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, min_tip_materials, max_tip_materials, avg_tip_materials FROM per_year_stats ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.min_tip_materials, i.max_tip_materials, i.avg_tip_materials, (i.avg_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(avg_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte i ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, which subject from the Mathematics department offered in the fall term had the highest number of enrolled students, and by how much did this enrollment exceed the average enrollment for Mathematics fall subjects that year? Please show the academic year, subject id, subject title, the number of enrolled students, and the deviation from the average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) , max_enrollment_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - a.avg_enrollment) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN max_enrollment_per_year m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrollment JOIN avg_enrollment_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and, for each school, the number of such subjects offered in that school. Only include schools where at least 2 such subjects are offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.subject_count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ) sc ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each academic term in 2022, list the term code, term description, the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term with at least 3 lecture units, the total lecture units for those subjects, and the instructor who teaches the most such subjects in that term, along with the count of subjects they teach. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(cso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS total_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.num_subjects_offered, icte.total_lecture_units, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Top_Instructor, t1.Subject_Count FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ata.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t1 ON icte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE AND t1.Subject_Count = ( SELECT MAX(t2.Subject_Count) FROM ( SELECT ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT cso2.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata2 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = cso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND cso2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso2.LECTURE_UNITS >= 3 AND cso2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ata2.TERM_CODE, cso2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) t2 WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE ) ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE;

question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the number of Mathematics (Course 18) subjects offered that year, and the deviation of this count from the average number of Mathematics subjects offered per academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.num_subjects, (inner_cte.num_subjects - avg_counts.avg_num_subjects) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(num_subjects) AS avg_num_subjects FROM inner_cte ) avg_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2022 by the Mathematics department that have at least one associated TIP material, show the subject ID, subject title, term code, term description, and the highest rank that any subject achieved within its term (ordered by subject ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_rank_in_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and the latest term end date for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units

question: For all subjects offered in the academic year 2024 by the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, term description, and the number of subjects offered in the same term as each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inner_cte ic WHERE ic.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE) AS subjects_in_same_term FROM inner_cte i;

question: For each department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and indicate whether the minimum total units is above or below the average total units for that department and year ('ABOVE_AVERAGE' if above, 'BELOW_AVERAGE' if below, otherwise 'AVERAGE'). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), avg_units_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.num_unique_subjects, i.min_total_units, a.avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.min_total_units < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS min_units_category FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_cte a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each Mathematics department subject, list the subject ID, the minimum number of enrolled students, the average lecture units, and the total number of terms offered for each subject, for subjects where the number of enrolled students is between 2 and 10 or the academic year is at least 2020, and the term start date is between '01-JAN-20' and '31-DEC-22'. Additionally, for each subject, include a grand total row showing the overall minimum number of enrolled students, average lecture units, and total terms across all subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.TERM_CODE) AS total_terms FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = c.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ( (t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 2 AND 10) OR (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2020) ) AND a.TERM_START_DATE BETWEEN '01-JAN-20' AND '31-DEC-22' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, min_num_enrolled_students, avg_lecture_units, total_terms FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, MIN(min_num_enrolled_students) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(avg_lecture_units) AS avg_lecture_units, SUM(total_terms) AS total_terms FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID

question: For each term description in the academic year 2024, show the term description and the highest rank achieved by any Mathematics subject (ordered by subject code) within that term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(window_column) AS highest_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for each Mathematics (Course 18) subject offered in that year, what is the subject id, subject title, total units, and the deviation of its total units from the average total units of Mathematics subjects in that year, considering only years with more than 5 Mathematics subjects? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units_per_year AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units_per_year a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, deviation_from_avg DESC;

question: For each IAP activity that is not cancelled and is offered in a non-summer term, what is the highest number of distinct Mathematics subject titles offered in the same academic term as that activity? Show the IAP activity title and the highest such count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ata.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total number of lecture units in a single regular term for all subjects offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE, SUM(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS term_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL at_all JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON at_all.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at_all.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(term_lecture_units) AS highest_term_lecture_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, and the total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key), and the number of distinct courses offered by the Computer Science department in each room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, RoomCourseCounts.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY ) AS RoomCourseCounts ON inner_cte.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = RoomCourseCounts.FCLT_ROOM_KEY;

question: For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, department name, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, the average subject enrollment number for the department as the benchmark, and whether the subject is a 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% greater than average), 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' (at least 10% less than average), or 'AVERAGE'. Also, assign row numbers within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), dept_benchmark AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark FROM ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, d.benchmark, CASE WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > d.benchmark * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER < d.benchmark * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN dept_benchmark d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: From the top 5 Mathematics department subjects offered in the 2022 academic year with the highest maximum enrollment (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), display each subject's title, the maximum number of enrolled students, the term description in which this maximum occurred, and the name of the instructor most frequently responsible for the subject (along with the count of terms they taught it). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c.SUBJECT_ID HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.max_enrollment, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, imf.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS Most_Frequent_Instructor, imf.Terms_Taught FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(max_enrollment) AS max_enrollment, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_ID ) ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Terms_Taught, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_ID, t.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME ) imf ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = imf.SUBJECT_ID AND imf.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.max_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for Mathematics department subjects offered in the fall term with at least one TIP material, what are the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject, along with the total number of such subjects, and the earliest and latest term start dates for those subjects in that year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_term_start, MAX(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS latest_term_start FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the maximum subject enrollment number for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, what is the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, along with the activity title, the term description, and the subject title of the subject with the maximum lecture units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, MAX(CASE WHEN LECTURE_UNITS = (SELECT MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ic2 WHERE ic2.ACTIVITY_TITLE = inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND ic2.TERM_DESCRIPTION = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE ELSE NULL END) AS subject_title_with_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACTIVITY_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, the term description for the corresponding term, and the subject short title, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6;

question: For each HGN code in the Political Science department, what is the department name, the maximum number of lecture units among all subjects in the course catalog, and the subject title from the subject offered table, for subjects offered in the year 2012 with more than 2 lecture units, and only include those where the subject is also present in the SUBJECT_OFFERED table for the same year? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2 ) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED so ON i.HGN_CODE = so.HGN_CODE AND so.TERM_CODE LIKE '2012%'

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and what are the minimum, maximum, and average number of TIP materials per subject offered in that year, considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term, have at least one TIP material, and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18)? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_tip_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cca JOIN TIP_DETAIL td ON cca.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE AND cca.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cca.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cca.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cca.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cca.TERM_CODE, cca.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS min_tip_materials, MAX(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS max_tip_materials, AVG(inner_cte.num_tip_materials) AS avg_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each IAP activity offered in the 2021 January term that is associated with at least one subject with more than 3 lecture units and offered by the Mathematics department, show the activity title, the term description, the maximum number of lecture units among its associated catalog subjects, and the total number of such Mathematics subjects per activity. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON iap.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_math_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(inner_cte.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3;

question: For each department, give the department name and the highest total number of enrolled students in any term for subjects offered during terms that are not the current term, where the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and where the total number of enrolled students in that term is greater than 10. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(total_enrolled) AS highest_term_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects in the course catalog with a total of 12 units, offered in the fall term, and in the Mathematics department, show for each department the department name and the highest subject enrollment number among those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS highest_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: Show the minimum total units, the sum of lecture units, and the number of unique subjects for letter graded Mathematics department (Course 18) subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021, along with the department name and term description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units;

question: For each Mathematics department subject that is offered in the fall term and has a material status of 'U', what is the subject id, the minimum number of lecture units, the total sum of total units, and the deviation of its lecture units from the average lecture units of all such subjects? Please use data from the library reserve material details, academic terms, and course catalog subject offered tables. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lrm.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(ic.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, (ic.LECTURE_UNITS - avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units) AS deviation_from_avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte ) avg_lecture ON 1=1 GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, avg_lecture.avg_lecture_units;

question: For each academic year, give the academic year, the academic year description, and find the highest average total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term, have a material status of 'U' in the library reserve, and are offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each academic year, what is the academic year description, and for subjects offered in the fall term by the Mathematics department (Course 18) that are not variable units, what is the average total units for that year, and for each subject in that year, what is the deviation of its total units from the average? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) , avg_units AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_ID, i.TOTAL_UNITS, a.avg_total_units, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_units a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.SUBJECT_ID ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, but only include those records where the number of enrolled students is greater than the average number of enrolled students for their HGN code group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each academic year, list the academic year description, the total number of units for all subjects offered in terms with a term status of 'Previous' (where the total number of units is greater than 100), and for each such year, show the department name, subject code, and subject title for all Mathematics (Course 18) subjects included in the total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 100 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_units, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics';

question: Show the subject titles, department names, term descriptions, and the total number of letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in the academic year 2022, assigning row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For the Mathematics department, show the department name, the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 that is also present in the CIS course catalog, display the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH max_enrollment_per_dept AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), math_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_enrollment_per_dept.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, max_enrollment_per_dept.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept FROM max_enrollment_per_dept JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN math_subjects_2024 ms ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), list for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units the subject code, subject number, department name, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, along with the total number of graduate students in the department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G'. Also, include the department name and total number of such graduate students even if there are no matching subjects, showing NULL for subject code, subject number, and running sum in that case. Order the results by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectUnits AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students FROM SubjectUnits su LEFT JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, gs.total_graduate_students FROM GraduateStudents gs WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SubjectUnits su WHERE su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the course level, number of unique students, and minimum CIP program code for each department name and course level where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH math_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_dept_students AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL ) SELECT ms24.SUBJECT_CODE, ms24.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms24.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms24.SCHOOL_NAME, ms24.window_column, mds.COURSE_LEVEL, mds.student_count, mds.min_cip_code FROM math_subjects_2024 ms24 LEFT JOIN math_dept_students mds ON ms24.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: List all Mathematics subjects that are either (1) offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, showing the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, subject ID, and term code, or (2) offered in the academic year 2022 with at least one associated TIP material, showing the subject title, subject ID, term code, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term ordered by subject ID. For each row, also include a column indicating the reason for inclusion ('2024_12Units' for the first group and '2022_WithTIP' for the second group). The columns should be: subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, department rank, subject ID, term code, TIP term description, TIP term rank, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subjects2022WithTIP AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s2024.SUBJECT_CODE, s2024.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2024.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2024.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2024.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2024.window_column, s2024.SUBJECT_ID, s2024.TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_window_column, '2024_12Units' AS Reason FROM Subjects2024 s2024 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, s2022.SUBJECT_ID, s2022.TERM_CODE, s2022.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2022.window_column AS TIP_window_column, '2022_WithTIP' AS Reason FROM Subjects2022WithTIP s2022 ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject in the Mathematics department that is offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', and calculate the normalized running sum rounded (the running sum of subject codes divided by the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department), ordered by the normalized running sum in descending order.
SQL: WITH SubjectUnits AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students, ROUND(su.window_column / NULLIF(gs.total_graduate_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_sum FROM SubjectUnits su JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_running_sum DESC;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA is greater than 10, show the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each subject in the course catalog with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrollment de JOIN MathSubjects ms ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.window_column;

question: For each department name and its corresponding administrative department name where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), list the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, and the number of subjects offered in the fall term from the Mathematics department for the top 10 department names and academic years with the highest number of subjects offered. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptAgg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT da.DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, da.department_count, da.min_budget_code, ts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ts.subject_count FROM DeptAgg da JOIN TopSubjects ts ON da.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the course level, the number of unique students, and the minimum CIP program code among their courses where the department is degree granting and the department is Mathematics. List the results ordered by school name, subject code, and course level. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subjects2024Math12Units AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathDeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.student_count, m.min_cip_code FROM Subjects2024Math12Units s JOIN MathDeptStudentStats m ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, m.COURSE_LEVEL;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department, ordered by department code and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathGradStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgs.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects ms JOIN MathGradStudents mgs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, and the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_running_sum AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_grad_students AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT srs.SUBJECT_CODE, srs.SUBJECT_NUMBER, srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, srs.window_column, mgs.total_graduate_students FROM subject_running_sum srs LEFT JOIN math_grad_students mgs ON srs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY srs.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the department is degree granting and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, and for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, what is the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH max_enrollment_math AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), math_2024_12units AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT mem.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mem.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, mem.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, m12.SUBJECT_CODE, m12.SUBJECT_TITLE AS UNITS12_SUBJECT_TITLE, m12.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS UNITS12_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m12.SCHOOL_NAME, m12.window_column FROM max_enrollment_math mem JOIN math_2024_12units m12 ON mem.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m12.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For each department name and school name where the student year is 'G' and the department is Mathematics (Course 18), and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department, provide the department name, school name, number of students, minimum office phone number, subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For the Mathematics department, list the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the department is degree granting and the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the school name, and the rank within each school name group (ordered by subject code) for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units. Show all columns in the order: department name, subject title, maximum number of enrolled students, subject code, school name, and rank. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CombinedMath AS ( SELECT me.DEPARTMENT_NAME, me.SUBJECT_TITLE, me.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.window_column FROM MaxEnrollment me JOIN MathSubjects2024 ms ON me.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedMath ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE;
