question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the Mathematics department has a total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not the current term greater than 10, show the subject title, department name, total units, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and the total number of enrolled students in the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ), MathDeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.row_num_window, mde.total_enrolled FROM MathSubjects2022 ms JOIN MathDeptEnrolled mde ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the subject title, the school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ), MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column FROM MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment m JOIN MathSubjects2024 s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.window_column, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each department name and school name in the Mathematics department (Course 18) where the student year is 'G', list the department name, school name, number of students, minimum office phone number, and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 units in Mathematics, show the subject code, subject number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentStudentStats dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms2022 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of students in the Mathematics department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students, ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptStudents AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), CombinedMathInfo AS ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.student_count, mds.unique_student_years FROM MathSubjects2024 ms JOIN MathDeptStudents mds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedMathInfo ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID;

question: List all subjects that are either (1) offered in the academic year 2022 by the Mathematics department and have at least one associated TIP material, showing the subject ID, subject title, term code, term description, and the rank of each subject within its term (ordered by subject ID), or (2) offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18) in the term '2019FA' with course materials, showing the subject ID, subject title, term code, NULL as term description, and a dense rank over the department name (ordered by department name). Present the subject ID, subject title, term code, term description, and the rank column in that order, combining both sets of results. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ), CombinedSubjects AS ( SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column FROM Subquery1 s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subquery2 s2 ) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of students in that department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students, ordered by department code and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subject_info AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_student_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT si.SUBJECT_ID, si.SUBJECT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_NUMBER, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, si.SUBJECT_TITLE, si.LECTURE_UNITS, si.LAB_UNITS, si.TOTAL_UNITS, si.GRADE_TYPE, si.GRADE_RULE, si.min_total_units_by_dept, ds.student_count, ds.unique_student_years FROM subject_info si LEFT JOIN dept_student_stats ds ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.DEPARTMENT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', ordered by subject code and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathGradStudentCounts AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgsc.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2024 ms JOIN MathGradStudentCounts mgsc ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each academic year, what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, the term description for the corresponding term, the department name, the number of unique subjects, and the minimum total units offered, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units, and only departments and academic years where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics? List the academic year, highest total units, term description, department name, number of unique subjects, and minimum total units in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), DeptYearStats AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_unique_subjects, ds.min_total_units FROM MaxUnitsPerYear mu JOIN DeptYearStats ds ON mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, ds.num_unique_subjects DESC

question: For each subject in the Mathematics department that is offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and is also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each department (Chemistry or Biology) and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, provide the count of subjects and the minimum start date of the term for that department and year, along with the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term for the same academic year (if it is among the top 10 years for Mathematics fall offerings). Show the department, academic year, Chemistry/Biology subject count, minimum term start date, and Mathematics fall subject count, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptYearEnrolledSubjects AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), TopMathFallSubjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT d.department, d.academic_year, d.subject_count AS chem_bio_subject_count, d.min_term_start_date, t.subject_count AS math_fall_subject_count FROM DeptYearEnrolledSubjects d LEFT JOIN TopMathFallSubjects t ON d.academic_year = t.academic_year ORDER BY d.department, d.academic_year;

question: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the total number of enrolled students in both library and tip subjects for terms in 2014FA or 2017JA is greater than 10, list the department name, the total number of enrolled students, and for each subject in the course catalog with a total of 12 units offered in the fall term, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, total units, whether the subject is offered in the fall term, the offering department name, the subject enrollment number, and the row number within the department ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DepartmentEnrollment AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), MathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrollment de JOIN MathSubjects ms ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.window_column;

question: For each subject code and subject number in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, list the department name, school name, number of graduate students, minimum office phone number, and the running sum of subject codes within the department, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: List the subject title, total units, department name, school name, dense rank over the department code ordered by department code, and the total number of enrolled students in non-current terms (where the total number of enrolled students is greater than 10) for each subject offered by degree-granting Mathematics departments with a non-null subject code description. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectSummary AS ( SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), DeptEnrollment AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME, ss.window_column, de.total_enrolled FROM SubjectSummary ss JOIN DeptEnrollment de ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each department and subject code in the Political Science department where the responsible faculty member's office is not null, provide the department name, subject code, number of unique subjects, and the minimum office phone number of the responsible faculty member, along with the subject code description, subject department name, subject school name, course description, course department name, course school name, course level, and the dense rank over the course level ordered by course level, for graduate-level Political Science courses where the subject code description is not null. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS ( SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE ), PoliticalScienceCourseDescriptions AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank, scd.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NOT NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' ) SELECT pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pss.num_unique_subjects, pss.min_office_phone, pscd.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pscd.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, pscd.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, pscd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pscd.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, pscd.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, pscd.COURSE_LEVEL, pscd.course_level_dense_rank FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectStats pss JOIN PoliticalScienceCourseDescriptions pscd ON pss.SUBJECT_CODE = pscd.COURSE ORDER BY pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pscd.course_level_dense_rank;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, and the total number of graduate students in degree-granting Mathematics departments whose student year is 'G'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.running_sum_enrolled_students, gms.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2014FA ms JOIN GraduateMathStudents gms ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each department (Chemistry or Biology) and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, display the department, academic year, the count of subjects, the minimum start date of the term, and the number of Mathematics subjects offered in the fall term for that academic year if the department and year are among the top 10 for Mathematics fall offerings; otherwise, show null for the Mathematics subject count. List the columns in the following order: department, academic year, Chemistry/Biology subject count, minimum term start date, and Mathematics fall subject count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_enrollment AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), math_fall_top10 AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT de.department, de.academic_year, de.subject_count AS chem_bio_subject_count, de.min_term_start_date, mft10.subject_count AS math_fall_subject_count FROM dept_enrollment de LEFT JOIN math_fall_top10 mft10 ON de.academic_year = mft10.academic_year ORDER BY de.department, de.academic_year;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of subject codes for each department and subject code where the department is degree granting and is Mathematics (Course 18), and the minimum department budget code, ordered by department code, subject code, and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH OfferedMathSubjects AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathDeptSubjectCodeStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT oms.SUBJECT_ID, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, oms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, oms.SUBJECT_TITLE, oms.LECTURE_UNITS, oms.LAB_UNITS, oms.TOTAL_UNITS, oms.GRADE_TYPE, oms.GRADE_RULE, oms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.subject_code_count, mds.min_dept_budget_code FROM OfferedMathSubjects oms JOIN MathDeptSubjectCodeStats mds ON oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND oms.SUBJECT_CODE = mds.SUBJECT_CODE AND oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER

question: For each subject in the Mathematics department that was offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH SubjectStats2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), LibrarySubjectStats2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, s2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2022.window_column, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, l2014.TERM_DESCRIPTION, l2014.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM SubjectStats2022 s2022 JOIN LibrarySubjectStats2014FA l2014 ON s2022.SUBJECT_ID = l2014.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s2022.SUBJECT_CODE, l2014.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? List the department name, academic year, subject count, highest total units, and term description, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: For each Mathematics department that is degree granting and its corresponding administrative department name, show the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the subject title, the department full name, the offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, for subjects offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, ordered by the subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_admin_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), math_subjects_2022 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM dept_admin_stats das JOIN math_subjects_2022 ms ON das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level, considering only courses with a non-null total units value, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Only include subjects where the offer school name matches the school name from the first part. Order the results by the highest average total units descending, then by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.highest_avg_total_units, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, subq2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.highest_avg_total_units DESC, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: List, for each department and academic year, either (1) the department name, academic year, count of subjects, minimum start date of the term, and term description for Chemistry or Biology departments where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, or (2) the department name, academic year, number of unique subjects, minimum total units offered, and latest term end date for the Mathematics department where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10. Indicate the reason for inclusion as 'ChemistryOrBiology' for Chemistry or Biology and 'Mathematics' for Mathematics. The columns should be: department name, academic year, subject count, minimum term start date, term description, number of unique subjects, minimum total units, latest term end date, and reason for inclusion, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH Subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) SELECT inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.academic_year ORDER BY inner_cte.department, inner_cte.academic_year ), Subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units ) SELECT department AS department_name, academic_year, subject_count, min_term_start_date, TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS latest_term_end_date, 'ChemistryOrBiology' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 UNION ALL SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name, ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, NULL AS subject_count, NULL AS min_term_start_date, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, num_unique_subjects, min_total_units, latest_term_end_date, 'Mathematics' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 ORDER BY department_name, academic_year;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, school name, administrative department name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name, along with the term description, the minimum total units, the sum of lecture units, and the number of unique subjects for letter graded Mathematics department subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021. Additionally, for each administrative department name, include a grand total of the number of such courses in the format of (null, null, null, administrative department name, total courses, term description, minimum total units, sum of lecture units, number of unique subjects). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), CourseTotals AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte_1 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathSpringSubjects AS ( SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte_2 WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.min_total_units, ms.sum_lecture_units, ms.num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte_1 ic JOIN MathSpringSubjects ms ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.min_total_units, ms.sum_lecture_units, ms.num_unique_subjects FROM CourseTotals ct JOIN MathSpringSubjects ms ON ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each school, provide the school name and the highest average total units for degree-granting courses offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18), grouped by course level (undergraduate or graduate), considering only courses with a non-null total units value, along with, for each subject offered in the academic year 2022 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, the subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and the department phone number. List the school name, highest average total units, subject title, department name, department full name, offer school name, average number of enrolled students in the window, and department phone number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subquery1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, ccc.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS IS NOT NULL AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL ) subquery1 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC ), subquery2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ) SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.highest_avg_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subquery1 s1 CROSS JOIN subquery2 s2;

question: For each academic year and department in Mathematics, what is the average, minimum, and maximum of the total units for subjects offered in that year and department (considering only subjects offered in the current term with more than 0 total units), and what is the deviation of the average total units from the overall average total units for all such Mathematics subjects in the current term? Additionally, for each subject code in Mathematics where the department is degree-granting, what is the subject code, subject code description, the running sum of department budget codes within each school (ordered by department code), and whether the department's budget code is above average, below average, or average compared to other Mathematics departments in the same school? Present the results with columns: academic year, department name, average total units, minimum total units, maximum total units, deviation from overall average, subject code, subject code description, running sum of department budget code, and budget category, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND SUBJECT_SUMMARY.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, (AVG(ic.TOTAL_UNITS) - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte ) overall GROUP BY ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, overall.avg_total_units ORDER BY deviation_from_overall_avg DESC ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.SCHOOL_CODE, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), avg_budget AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_CODE, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY SCHOOL_CODE ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.running_sum_dept_budget_code, CASE WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > a.avg_budget_code THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE < a.avg_budget_code THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS budget_category, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN avg_budget a ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = a.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.min_total_units, s1.max_total_units, s1.deviation_from_overall_avg, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.running_sum_dept_budget_code, s2.budget_category FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting and has a course level of 'G', show the course description, department name, school name, the administrative department name, and the dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name. Additionally, for each administrative department name, include a grand total of the number of such courses in the format of (null, null, null, administrative department name, null, total courses). Also, show the minimum total units, the sum of lecture units, and the number of unique subjects for letter graded Mathematics department subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021, along with the department name and term description (with all other columns as null). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte_1 AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), CourseTotals AS ( SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte_1 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte_2 AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS sum_lecture_units, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, NULL AS term_description FROM inner_cte_1 ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM CourseTotals ct UNION ALL SELECT NULL, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte_2 WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION

question: For each of the top 10 degree-granting departments (excluding Political Science) that have at least one subject with more than 0 enrolled students, list the department name, the total count of unique subject titles, and the total number of enrolled students across all their subjects, along with, for each subject offered in the academic year 2022 that is letter graded and in the Mathematics department, the subject title, department name, term description, total units, and the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_subjects_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME != 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE != '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ), math_letter_graded_2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrolled_students, mlg.SUBJECT_TITLE, mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPT_NAME, mlg.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mlg.TOTAL_UNITS, mlg.window_column FROM dept_subjects_enrollment dse CROSS JOIN math_letter_graded_2022 mlg;

question: For each subject offered in the academic year 2024 in the Mathematics department with a total of 12 units, show the term description (do not repeat the term if it is the same as the previous row), department name, the highest average number of enrolled students in any term for subjects offered by that department in the 2022FA term that are offered this year (only for degree-granting departments and excluding Chemistry), subject code, subject number, subject title, the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, the school name, and the total number of such subjects in the department for that term. Sort the table by term and department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH dept_highest_avg_enrollment AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ), math_subjects_2024 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT m.term_description, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.highest_avg_enrollment, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.subject_rank_in_dept, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.subject_count_in_dept FROM math_subjects_2024 m LEFT JOIN dept_highest_avg_enrollment d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.term_description, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each degree-granting department with a department budget code above 100000, excluding the Political Science department (Course 17), that also offers a Mathematics subject in 2022 with 12 total units where the number of enrolled students in that subject is greater than the average for its HGN code group, list the department code, department name, school name, the number of unique courses offered by the department, the total number of units for all those courses, the subject code of the course with the highest number of total units in that department and that course's total units, as well as the subject title, department full name, offer school name, and the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code for the Mathematics subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH DegreeGrantingDepartments AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE AS max_units_subject_code, c.TOTAL_UNITS AS max_subject_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN ( SELECT c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG c1 JOIN ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_units FROM CIS_COURSE_CATALOG GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE ) c2 ON c1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c1.TOTAL_UNITS = c2.max_units ) c ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.HGN_CODE, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT HGN_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_per_hgn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY GROUP BY HGN_CODE ) a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled_per_hgn ) SELECT dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dgd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgd.SCHOOL_NAME, dgd.num_unique_courses, dgd.total_units, dgd.max_units_subject_code, dgd.max_subject_total_units, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM DegreeGrantingDepartments dgd JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dgd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the term '2014FA' with more than 5 enrolled students in the Mathematics department (Course 18) whose total units in a given academic year are greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, subject title, number of enrolled students, the row number within each department name group ordered by subject code, the responsible faculty name, the academic year description, the total units, and the units per enrolled student (rounded, calculated as total units divided by number of enrolled students), ordered by academic year description and subject code.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.window_column, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, ROUND(s2.TOTAL_UNITS / NULLIF(s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0), 2) AS Units_Per_Enrolled_Student FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_CODE = s2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s1.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, and the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key). Additionally, indicate whether the room is a 'LARGE_ROOM' (area at least 500), 'MEDIUM_ROOM' (area between 400 and 500), or 'SMALL_ROOM' (area less than 400). For each such subject offered in the School of Engineering in 2019 by the Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, also provide the subject ID, department name, the number of enrolled graduate students whose department is degree-granting, and the total number of enrolled students in the subject. Show the columns in the following order: room key, building room, area, subject title, academic year, room rank, room size category, subject ID, department name, number of enrolled graduate students, and total number of enrolled students. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), cte1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, inner_cte1.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte1.AREA, inner_cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.window_column, CASE WHEN inner_cte1.AREA >= 500 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN inner_cte1.AREA >= 400 AND inner_cte1.AREA < 500 THEN 'MEDIUM_ROOM' ELSE 'SMALL_ROOM' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte1 ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_enrolled_grad_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.num_enrolled_grad_students, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte2 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID = tso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' LIMIT 1 ) ) SELECT cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cte1.BUILDING_ROOM, cte1.AREA, cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte1.window_column, cte1.room_size_category, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte2.num_enrolled_grad_students, cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.SUBJECT_TITLE = cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE cte1.AREA > 400 AND cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY cte1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, cte2.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, where the subject title and department name match, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description for 2014FA, the department name for 2014FA, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, the subject code, subject number, the term description for 2024, the department name for 2024, and the maximum subject enrollment number for each subject. Order the results by subject ID, subject code, and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 9 ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION ) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2014FA, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME_2014FA, subq1.running_sum_enrolled_students, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, subq2.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TERM_DESCRIPTION_2024, subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME_2024, subq2.max_enrollment FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE = subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For each academic year and term, what is the highest total units among all Mathematics department subjects offered that year (considering only subjects offered this year with more than 6 total units), the term description for the corresponding term, and the subject short title, along with, for subjects in the "Engineering" school with a total of 1 unit offered by the "Electrical Engineering and Computer Science" department in the same term, the department name, the maximum number of enrolled students for any such subject in each department, the subject ID, subject title, the term description for the EECS subject, and the rank of each subject within its department name group ordered by subject ID? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH math_max_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 ), eecs_eng_subjects AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_dept, ss.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS = 1 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept, TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, subject_rank_in_dept, TERM_CODE ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT mmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mmu.max_total_units, mmu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mmu.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ees.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ees.max_enrollment, ees.SUBJECT_ID, ees.SUBJECT_TITLE, ees.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS EECS_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ees.subject_rank_in_dept FROM math_max_units mmu JOIN eecs_eng_subjects ees ON mmu.TERM_CODE = ees.TERM_CODE;

question: For all letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in the academic year 2022, show the subject title, department name, term description, the total number of letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in 2022, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, and for each matching department and academic year where the subject enrollment number is greater than 10 and the department is Mathematics, provide the academic year, the number of unique subjects, the minimum total units offered, and the latest term end date for those subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS join_department_name FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, Total_Subjects.Total_Subjects, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.join_department_name FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) AS Total_Subjects ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Subjects.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, at.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_CODE ) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units, MAX(at.TERM_END_DATE) AS latest_term_end_date FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.num_unique_subjects, inner_cte.min_total_units ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.Total_Subjects, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.num_unique_subjects, s2.min_total_units, s2.latest_term_end_date FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.join_department_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

question: For all degree-granting departments except the Management department, list the department code, department name, corresponding administrative department name, the graduate level of courses, and the total number of distinct courses per department, along with the academic year description, subject code, and total units for Mathematics subjects in each academic year that have a total units value greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year. Present the results in the order of department code, academic year description, and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
