SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, cte1.num_distinct_courses, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN cte2 ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = cte2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For all degree-granting departments except the Management department, list the department code, department name, corresponding administrative department name, the graduate level of courses, and the total number of distinct courses per department, along with, for each academic year, the academic year description, subject code, and total units for Mathematics subjects that have a total units value greater than the average total units for Mathematics subjects in that academic year. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON ccso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte2 i JOIN ( SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ) a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, cte1.num_distinct_courses, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM cte1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN cte2 ON ccso.SUBJECT_CODE = cte2.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For each department name and course level in the Mathematics department (Course 18) where the total number of enrolled students in offered subjects is greater than the average number of enrolled students for that department and the subjects are degree-granting, provide the number of unique courses and the minimum total units among those subjects, along with the term description, the minimum total units, the sum of lecture units, and the number of unique subjects for letter graded Mathematics subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021. List the columns in the following order: department name, course level, number of unique courses, minimum total units from the first set, term description, minimum total units from the second set, sum of lecture units, and number of unique subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ), dept_avg AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN dept_avg a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.min_total_units, inner_cte2.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte2 WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.min_total_units, inner_cte2.sum_lecture_units ) SELECT q1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, q1.COURSE_LEVEL, q1.course_count, q1.min_total_units AS min_total_units_subq1, q2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, q2.min_total_units AS min_total_units_subq2, q2.sum_lecture_units, q2.num_unique_subjects FROM subq1 q1 JOIN subq2 q2 ON q1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = q2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY q1.COURSE_LEVEL, q2.TERM_DESCRIPTION

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are letter graded and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject title, department name, term description, the total units, and assign row numbers within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title. Additionally, for those subjects that have a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, also show the department full name, offer school name, the average number of enrolled students in a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows grouped by the HGN code, and the department phone number from the SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT table. Present the results with the columns in the following order: subject title, department name, term description, total units, window column, department full name, offer school name, average number of enrolled students in window, and department phone number, and order the results by subject title. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq1 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte1 inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER ( PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte2 inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s2.avg_num_enrolled_students_window, s2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM subq1 s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, and only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their respective school. Additionally, for each such subject, show the term description and the number of subjects offered in the same term as that subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), cte1 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), cte2 AS ( SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TERM_CODE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inner_cte2 ic WHERE ic.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE) AS subjects_in_same_term FROM inner_cte2 i ) SELECT c1.SUBJECT_CODE, c1.SUBJECT_TITLE, c1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.window_column, c2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, c2.subjects_in_same_term FROM cte1 c1 JOIN cte2 c2 ON c1.SUBJECT_CODE = c2.SUBJECT_CODE AND c1.SUBJECT_TITLE = c2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY c1.SCHOOL_NAME, c1.window_column;

question: For each academic year and term, what is the highest total units among all Mathematics subjects offered that year (considering only subjects offered this year with more than 6 total units), the term description, the subject short title, and the term code for that subject, along with, for the top 10 Chemistry subjects (among regular terms, with more than 5 enrolled students, and with course materials), the subject title, offering department name, total number of reserved course materials, minimum academic year, the term code with the most reserved materials for that subject and department, and the count of reserved materials in that term, matching the Mathematics and Chemistry results by term code with the most reserved materials. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH math_max_units AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = at.TERM_DESCRIPTION JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.max_total_units AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 ), chem_reserved_materials AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, a.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, a.TERM_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(ic.num_reserved_materials) AS total_reserved_materials, MIN(ic.min_academic_year) AS min_academic_year, tc.max_term_code AS term_code_with_most_reserved, tc.max_reserved_materials AS reserved_materials_in_term FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE AS max_term_code, num_reserved_materials AS max_reserved_materials FROM ( SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, num_reserved_materials, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY num_reserved_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) tc ON ic.SUBJECT_TITLE = tc.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tc.max_term_code, tc.max_reserved_materials ORDER BY total_reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT mmu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mmu.max_total_units, mmu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mmu.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, mmu.TERM_CODE AS MATH_TERM_CODE, crm.SUBJECT_TITLE, crm.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, crm.total_reserved_materials, crm.min_academic_year, crm.term_code_with_most_reserved, crm.reserved_materials_in_term FROM math_max_units mmu LEFT JOIN chem_reserved_materials crm ON mmu.TERM_CODE = crm.term_code_with_most_reserved

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, and the total number of unique course titles offered by their department (only for departments that grant degrees, have at least 5 courses listed in the course catalog, and are not the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department). Only include those subjects whose total units exceed the average total units for their respective school. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), school_avg AS ( SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM ( SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), dept_courses AS ( SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte2 ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic.num_courses >= 5 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte1 i JOIN school_avg s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN dept_courses d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column;

question: For all rooms with an area greater than 400 in the Stata building, show the room key, building room, area, the subject title of the course meeting in that room that is offered by the Computer Science department, the academic year, the department name, the rank of each room within its building (ordered by room key), and the number of distinct courses offered by the Computer Science department in each room. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte1 AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ), RoomCourseCounts AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY ), inner_cte2 AS ( SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ) SELECT ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic1.BUILDING_ROOM, ic1.AREA, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, rcc.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte1 ic1 JOIN RoomCourseCounts rcc ON ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = rcc.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN inner_cte2 ic2 ON ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = ic2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AND ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic1.window_column = ic2.window_column ORDER BY ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR;

question: For each department among Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department, the minimum total units and the sum of lecture units for letter graded subjects offered in the Spring Term 2021 in the Mathematics department, and the names of the responsible faculty for those Spring 2021 subjects, listing the columns in the following order: department name, maximum number of enrolled students, responsible faculty name for the maximum enrolled course, average number of enrolled students, minimum total units, sum of lecture units, and responsible faculty name for the Spring 2021 subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ( (sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry') ) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, avg_stats.avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ic JOIN ( SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND (lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 18 OR lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = 5) GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ) avg_stats ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = avg_stats.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ), subq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON c.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.sum_lecture_units, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS MAX_ENROLL_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.avg_num_enrolled_students, s2.min_total_units, s2.sum_lecture_units, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS SPRING_2021_RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 s1 JOIN subq2 s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME;

question: For each subject offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students and offered by the Mathematics department, show the subject ID, subject title, the term description, the department name from the course catalog, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, the total number of graduate students in degree-granting Mathematics departments whose student year is 'G', and for each subject, also include the course description long and the school name from the course description table. Do not repeat the subject ID if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by subject ID and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH GraduateMathStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ), MathSubjects2014FA AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.running_sum_enrolled_students, gms.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2014FA ms JOIN GraduateMathStudents gms ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID END AS SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.running_sum_enrolled_students, inner_cte.total_graduate_students, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG, scd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME;

question: For each subject code and subject number in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, list the department name, school name, number of graduate students, minimum office phone number, the running sum of subject codes within the department, and the department phone number. Do not repeat the department name if it is the same as the previous row. Sort the table by department name and subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column, ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE) = DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, SCHOOL_NAME, student_count, min_office_phone, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, window_column, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department, what is the department name, the subject title with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2019FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 10), the maximum number of enrolled students, the subject code, the subject title, the school name, and the rank within each school name group ordered by subject code for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units, along with the responsible faculty name for each 2024 subject? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 ) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte m JOIN ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.window_column, s.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term, and the average number of lecture units for those subjects, for the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects from the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), TopSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tsc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tsc.subject_count, tsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectCounts tsc ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tsc.subject_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC;

question: For each department and academic year where the number of enrolled students in a subject is greater than 0, and the department is either Chemistry or Biology, provide the department, academic year, count of subjects, and the minimum start date of the term. Additionally, for each department and academic year, include the minimum academic year and the sum of total units for subjects that are offered in the fall term and belong to the Mathematics department, considering only library reserve material details with material status 'U'. Also, for each such Mathematics subject, include the earliest term start date from the ACADEMIC_TERMS table. The columns should be: department, academic year, subject count, minimum term start date, minimum academic year for Mathematics fall term subjects with library material status 'U', sum of total units for those Mathematics subjects, and the earliest term start date for those Mathematics subjects. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ), MathFallUnits AS ( SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, MIN(at.TERM_START_DATE) AS earliest_math_term_start_date FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, m.min_academic_year, m.sum_total_units, m.earliest_math_term_start_date FROM inner_cte i CROSS JOIN MathFallUnits m;

question: For the top 10 department names and their corresponding academic years with the highest number of subjects offered (considering only subjects that are offered in the fall term and are from the Mathematics department), what is the highest total units among all subjects offered in that year from the Mathematics department, and what is the term description for the corresponding term, considering only subjects that are offered this year and have more than 6 total units? Additionally, for each of these department-year pairs, what is the number of unique subject titles offered in that year by the Mathematics department with more than 6 total units? List the department name, academic year, subject count, highest total units, term description, and the count of unique subject titles with more than 6 units, in that order. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6 ), TopDepartments AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.max_total_units, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COALESCE(stc.unique_subject_titles, 0) AS unique_subject_titles_with_gt6_units FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN ( SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ) stc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC;

question: Show the department names, school names, the number of graduate students, the minimum office phone number, and for each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 units in Mathematics, display the subject code, subject number, subject title, and the total number of such subjects per department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.min_office_phone, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ( SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) subj_count ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cso.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the course description, administrative department name, and dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name for each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting, has a course level of 'G', and is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each such subject, show the number of subjects offered in 2024 with 12 units in the same department and the average total units for all subjects in that department in 2024. The columns should be: subject code, subject title, department name, school name, rank within each school name group, course description, administrative department name, dense rank over the administrative department name, number of 12-unit subjects in 2024 in the department, and average total units for 2024 in the department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), CourseStats AS ( SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ), DeptStats AS ( SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_12_unit_subjects_2024, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_2024 FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, cs.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, cs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.admin_dept_dense_rank, ds.num_12_unit_subjects_2024, ds.avg_total_units_2024 FROM inner_cte icte JOIN CourseStats cs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN DeptStats ds ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, cs.admin_dept_dense_rank;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject number, subject title, department name, term description, and the rank of each subject within its department ordered by subject code, along with the department name, school name, the highest number of degree-granting undergraduate courses in the Mathematics department (Course 18), and the subject short title and subject description for each subject. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_CODE AS join_subject_code FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), math_dept_course_count AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses, 'Mathematics' AS join_department_name FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column, mdc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdc.SCHOOL_NAME, mdc.num_courses, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN math_dept_course_count mdc JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the number of students in that department, and the total number of unique student years represented among those students, but only include those subjects where the total units is greater than the average total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), dept_student_stats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, ic.LAB_UNITS, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.GRADE_RULE, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, ds.student_count, ds.unique_student_years FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN dept_student_stats ds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE ic.TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', and for each subject, also show the full department name and the school name from the department table. Calculate the normalized running sum rounded (the running sum of subject codes divided by the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department), ordered by the normalized running sum in descending order.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), GraduateStudents AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ROUND(icte.window_column / NULLIF(gs.total_graduate_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_sum FROM inner_cte icte JOIN GraduateStudents gs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_running_sum DESC;

question: Show the department names, the corresponding SIS subject code, subject code descriptions, graduate level, the total number of courses per department, and for the Mathematics department, the number of subjects offered in the Library Subject Offered table during terms that are not the current term and have more than 5 enrolled students (null for other departments). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ) , Total_Courses AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) , Math_Library_Subjects AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS Math_Library_Subjects FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, tc.Total_Courses, mls.Math_Library_Subjects FROM inner_cte icte JOIN Total_Courses tc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tc.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN Math_Library_Subjects mls ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mls.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE

question: For the Management department, show the department name, the title of the subject with the maximum number of students enrolled in any subject offered by that department in the 2022FA term (where the maximum enrollment is greater than 15), the maximum number of enrolled students, and for each subject offered in the academic year 2024 that is also present in the CIS course catalog, display the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, ordered by department code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH max_enrollment_per_dept AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ( SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 15 ), management_subjects_2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Management' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME, max_enrollment_per_dept.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, max_enrollment_per_dept.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept FROM max_enrollment_per_dept JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON max_enrollment_per_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN management_subjects_2024 ms ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 with a total of 12 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject title, department name, school name, and rank within each school name group ordered by subject code, along with the course description, administrative department name, and dense rank over the administrative department name ordered by the administrative department name for each course in the Mathematics department that is degree granting, has a course level of 'G', and is offered by the Mathematics department (Course 18). Additionally, for each subject, display the subject description and the responsible faculty name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = icte.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT sad ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, admin_dept_dense_rank

question: For each subject code and subject number in the Mathematics department (Course 18) offered in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, list the department name, school name, number of graduate students, minimum office phone number, the running sum of subject codes within the department, and the subject title, ordered by subject code. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptStudentStats AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathSubjects2022 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.min_office_phone, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.window_column, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER = cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE;

question: For each subject code in degree-granting departments where the department is Mathematics, and for subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department, show the subject code, subject code description, department name, school name, rank of the subject code within each school name group ordered by subject code, subject ID, subject number, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, and the subject description from the CIS course catalog, ordered by school name, rank, and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH SubjectCodeRanks AS ( SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), MathSubjects2024 AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT scr.SUBJECT_CODE, scr.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scr.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scr.SCHOOL_NAME, scr.window_column, ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept FROM SubjectCodeRanks scr JOIN MathSubjects2024 ms ON scr.SUBJECT_CODE = ms.SUBJECT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.window_column, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, ic.LAB_UNITS, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.GRADE_RULE, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, ccc.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.window_column, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, provide the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term, and the average total units of those subjects for the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered, considering only degree-granting departments and subjects from the Mathematics department. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DeptAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), TopSubjectCounts AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tsc.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tsc.subject_count, tsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM DeptAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectCounts tsc ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tsc.subject_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC;

question: From the top 10 Mathematics department subjects in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units and also offered by the library in the term "2014FA" with more than 5 enrolled students, display each subject's code, number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, the running sum of enrolled students within each offer department code group ordered by subject ID, and the name of the responsible faculty member for the subject as listed in the library offerings. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH Subquery1 AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ), Subquery2 AS ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID ) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 s1 JOIN Subquery2 s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY window_column DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For the Mathematics department and its corresponding administrative department name, where the department is degree granting, list the department name, the administrative department name, the number of departments, the minimum department budget code, the academic year, the number of subjects offered in the fall term, and the average number of lecture units for those subjects, considering the top 10 academic years with the highest number of subjects offered in the fall term. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH DepartmentAdminStats AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ), TopSubjectOfferings AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, tso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tso.subject_count FROM DepartmentAdminStats das JOIN TopSubjectOfferings tso ON das.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tso.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tso.subject_count DESC, das.department_count DESC ) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, AVG(ccso.LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccso ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.department_count, icte.min_budget_code, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.department_count DESC;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the school name, the count of students in the department, and the subject title, but only for departments that are degree granting, have a non-null department name, and are either the Mathematics department or the Physics department. List the results ordered by subject code and subject number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, c.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c ON ic.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE AND ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER = c.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NOT NULL AND (d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8') GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, d.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER;

question: For the three academic terms with the highest number of subjects offered by the Mathematics department, what is the term code, the term description, the academic year description, and for each term, what is the average, minimum, and maximum total units of Mathematics subjects offered in that term, and is the average total units at least 10% higher than the minimum (label as 'HIGH_AVG'), at least 10% lower than the maximum (label as 'LOW_AVG'), or otherwise 'AVERAGE'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3 ) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > MIN(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG' WHEN AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) < MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM inner_cte icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cso ON icte.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC;

question: From the top 10 Mathematics department subjects in the 2022 academic year with at least 6 total units, show each subject's code, number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the subject title, the term description, and, for each subject, the library offer department with the highest number of enrolled students in the term "2014FA" (where more than 5 students are enrolled), along with that enrolled student count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Library_Offer_Dept, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Enrolled_Student_Count FROM inner_cte ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN ( SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS dept_rank FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 ) ranked_lso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ranked_lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ranked_lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ranked_lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS WHERE ranked_lso.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER LIMIT 10;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, and the minimum total units value over each department code group, but only include those subjects where the total units is greater than the average total units for all Mathematics subjects offered in 2024 and present in the CIS course catalog. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ) SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, SUBJECT_TITLE, LECTURE_UNITS, LAB_UNITS, TOTAL_UNITS, GRADE_TYPE, GRADE_RULE, min_total_units_by_dept FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > ( SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte ) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER ;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the total number of graduate students in the Mathematics department whose department is degree granting and whose student year is 'G', as well as the school name and department phone number for each department, ordered by department code and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ), MathGradStudentCount AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.LECTURE_UNITS, icte.LAB_UNITS, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.GRADE_RULE, icte.min_total_units_by_dept, mgsc.total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte icte LEFT JOIN MathGradStudentCount mgsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_ID

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2022 that are printed in the bulletin and belong to the Mathematics department (Course 18), where the Mathematics department has a total number of enrolled students in subjects offered during terms that are not the current term greater than 10, show the subject title, department name, total units, the row number within a window of 2 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by subject title, the total number of enrolled students in the department, and the name of the school the department belongs to. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ), MathDeptEnrolled AS ( SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.row_num_window, mde.total_enrolled, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte icte JOIN MathDeptEnrolled mde ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE;

question: For subjects offered in the academic year 2024 that are also present in the CIS course catalog and are in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject ID, subject code, subject number, department name, subject short title, subject title, lecture units, lab units, total units, grade type, grade rule, the minimum total units value over each department code group, the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department, and the full department description from SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ordered by department code and subject ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgs.total_graduate_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ( SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, min(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) ms JOIN ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) mgs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, ic.LAB_UNITS, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.GRADE_RULE, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, ic.total_graduate_students, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG AS department_description FROM inner_cte ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID;

question: For each subject offered in the 2022 academic year with a total of at least 6 units in the Mathematics department (Course 18), show the subject code, subject number, department name, the running sum of subject codes within each department ordered by subject code, the total number of graduate students whose department is degree granting, whose student year is 'G', and who are in the Mathematics department, and indicate whether the total number of such graduate students is above or below the average number of graduate students across all degree-granting departments with student year 'G'. Do not return any rounded answers.
