SQL: WITH completed_migration_rank_by_zone AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT instance_availability_zone, MAX(window_column) AS max_migration_rank_in_zone FROM inner_cte GROUP BY instance_availability_zone ), max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT key_name, MAX(total_vcpus) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM inner_cte GROUP BY key_name ) SELECT cmrz.max_migration_rank_in_zone, mtv.max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM completed_migration_rank_by_zone cmrz CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(max_total_vcpus_per_instance) AS max_total_vcpus_per_instance FROM max_total_vcpus_per_key_in_flare3 ) mtv WHERE cmrz.instance_availability_zone = 'flare3';

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded", return the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the rank within each availability zone ordered by instance ID, and the deviation of each instance ID from the average instance ID across all such instances, along with the completed migration status, maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL), and migration created timestamp for matching (non-deleted) instances where the completed migration’s memory utilization (MEMORY_PROCESSED divided by MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.ID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (ic.ID - ai.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ids ai), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m ON m.created_at = inner_cte.created_at AND m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75) SELECT q1.ID AS instance_id, q1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, q1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, q1.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, q1.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_instance_id, q1.deviation_from_avg_instance_id, q2.status AS completed_migration_status, q2.max_memory_total AS completed_migration_max_memory_total, q2.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For instances whose display name is "forge", return the instance UUID, hostname, cached network_info JSON, and the running sum of instance IDs within each VM state (ordered by instance ID), along with the total number of "forge" instances per VM state and the average of those per-state totals across all VM states; also include (as overall migration context) the source compute, destination compute, memory processed ratio, and the total count of completed migrations for instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state where more than 75% of migration memory has been processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH forge_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, c.NETWORK_INFO, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ) SELECT inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_forge_instances_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances_in_state FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) AS state_counts ON state_counts.VM_STATE = ( SELECT i2.VM_STATE FROM INSTANCES AS i2 WHERE i2.UUID = inner_cte.UUID ) JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_forge_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM INSTANCES WHERE DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY VM_STATE ) AS per_state ) AS avg_state_counts ), completed_shelved_migrations AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) > 0.75) SELECT fi.UUID AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.HOSTNAME AS forge_instance_hostname, fi.NETWORK_INFO AS forge_cached_network_info_json, fi.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_vm_state, fi.total_forge_instances_in_state, fi.avg_forge_instances_per_state, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.memory_processed_ratio, csm.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM forge_instances fi CROSS JOIN completed_shelved_migrations csm;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is ether-60, list the migration ID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, cached network info, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration ID), along with the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations per destination compute; only include rows whose instance display name is also among the “shelved_offloaded” instances with total memory greater than 50000 MB and greater than the average total memory of those qualifying instances, and show that total memory value as well. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) AS per_dest ) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id ), high_memory_shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.total_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.total_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.DEST_HOST, md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_vm_state, md.cached_network_info, md.window_column, md.total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, md.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute, hmsi.total_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM migration_details md JOIN high_memory_shelved_instances hmsi ON md.instance_display_name = hmsi.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.migration_id;

question: For instances in VM state "shelved_offloaded" whose display name also has at least one completed migration with a per-status maximum memory_total greater than 0, list the instance ID, display name, availability zone, cached network info, the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID, its deviation from the average instance ID across all such shelved_offloaded instances, and the display name’s maximum-of-per-status maximum completed-migration memory_total. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH shelved_instances AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded'), avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.ID, ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (ic.ID - ai.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_ids ai ), completed_migration_memory_by_display_name AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT display_name, MAX(max_memory_total) AS max_of_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name ) SELECT si.ID AS instance_id, si.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, si.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, si.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, si.window_column AS rank_within_availability_zone_by_instance_id, si.deviation_from_avg_instance_id, cm.max_of_max_memory_total FROM shelved_instances si JOIN completed_migration_memory_by_display_name cm ON si.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.display_name ORDER BY si.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, si.ID;

question: For non-deleted instances (deleted = 0) whose memory_mb is above the average memory_mb of all non-deleted instances, and that also have at least 2 completed migrations, list the (non-repeated) migration destination host label, instance display name, instance UUID, instance memory_mb, cached network_info JSON, the migration status, the per-UUID average memory_mb window value ordered by destination host, and the total count of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH NonDeletedAboveAvgMemory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT display_name, vm_state, memory_mb, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) FROM inner_cte)), CompletedMigrationsWithWindow AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.UUID, i.MEMORY_MB, m.STATUS, m.DEST_HOST, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ORDER BY m.DEST_HOST ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_HOST) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID) = DEST_HOST THEN NULL ELSE DEST_HOST END AS dest_host, DISPLAY_NAME, UUID, MEMORY_MB, STATUS, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_HOST, UUID), CompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.instance_uuid AS uuid, COUNT(*) AS Completed_Migration_Count FROM migrations m WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY m.instance_uuid ) SELECT cm.dest_host, cm.display_name, cm.uuid, cm.memory_mb, nd.network_info, cm.status, cm.window_column AS Avg_Memory_MB_Within_UUID_By_DestHost, cmc.Completed_Migration_Count FROM CompletedMigrationsWithWindow cm JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = cm.uuid JOIN NonDeletedAboveAvgMemory nd ON nd.display_name = i.display_name AND nd.vm_state = i.vm_state AND nd.memory_mb = i.memory_mb JOIN CompletedMigrationCounts cmc ON cmc.uuid = cm.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND cmc.Completed_Migration_Count >= 2 ORDER BY cm.dest_host, cm.uuid;

question: For instances that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and have a migration status of "completed", return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the row number within the "completed" migration-status group ordered by instance UUID, and the deviation of that row number from the average row number across all such instances; additionally, for those same instances whose display name is among the top 10 display names with the most completed migrations, also show the completed-migration count for that display name and how far that count deviates from the average completed-migration count across those top 10 display names. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_source_compute, ic.migration_dest_compute, ic.window_column, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_row_number FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS ( SELECT AVG(migrations) AS avg_migrations FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.migrations, (ic.migrations - ac.avg_migrations) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte ac ORDER BY ic.migrations DESC ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_status, q1.migration_source_compute, q1.migration_dest_compute, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_row_number, q2.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name_in_top10, q2.deviation_from_avg AS deviation_from_avg_completed_migrations_in_top10 FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" (including their system metadata) whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of instances with the same VM state in "flare3", list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, metadata key and value, and the row number within each metadata key group ordered by instance UUID, along with the completed migration status, the maximum total migration memory (MEMORY_TOTAL), and the migration created timestamp, but only for completed migrations where MEMORY_PROCESSED divided by MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationMemoryStats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations m ON m.created_at = inner_cte.created_at AND m.status = inner_cte.status JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / m.memory_total) > 0.75 ), Flare3HighVcpuMetadata AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ), VmStateAverages AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.VCPUS * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM INSTANCES AS i WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.vcpus > ( SELECT vsa.avg_vcpus FROM VmStateAverages AS vsa WHERE vsa.vm_state = ic.vm_state ) ) SELECT f.instance_uuid, f.display_name, f.vm_state, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.metadata_key, f.metadata_value, f.window_column, mms.status AS migration_status, mms.max_memory_total, mms.created_at AS migration_created_at FROM Flare3HighVcpuMetadata f JOIN MigrationMemoryStats mms ON mms.display_name = f.display_name ORDER BY f.instance_uuid, f.metadata_key, f.window_column;

question: How many (1) completed migrations for instances on host "blaze8-12" have a 3-preceding/1-following windowed minimum instance memory (MB) that is greater than the average of that same windowed minimum across those migrations, and (2) instances in availability zone "flare3" running on host "blaze8-12" are returned when listing each instance’s VM-state row number and its memory deviation from the overall average memory? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH migration_mem_window AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT uuid, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, status, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ), instance_state_mem_stats AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_mem AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.window_column, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_mem am ), counts AS ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM migration_mem_window) AS migration_rows_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instance_state_mem_stats) AS instance_rows_count ) SELECT c.migration_rows_count, c.instance_rows_count FROM counts c;

question: For completed migrations, show the per-row migration/instance/system-metadata details for instances on host “ether-18” (with destination compute suppressed when it repeats), including for each destination compute the total rows returned and the minimum migration memory remaining; also include the host-level metric for host “blaze8-12” (the maximum across instances of each instance’s minimum observed memory remaining) and compute the ratio of the destination-compute minimum memory remaining to that blaze8-12 host metric.
SQL: WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND( ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4 ) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key;

question: For the top 10 instance display names (in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12' with system metadata KEY = 'image_image_type') ranked by average memory (MB), show each display name, its minimum instance ID, its average memory, whether any instance with that display name has system metadata KEY = 'image_image_location', and how many rows of completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12' (keeping only instances whose memory is > 75% of the maximum among those completed migrations) match that same display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH sq1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.min_instance_id, ic.avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 ON i2.UUID = ism2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = ic.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i2.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND ism2.KEY = 'image_image_location' ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_image_location_metadata FROM inner_cte ic ORDER BY ic.avg_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10 ), sq2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN ( SELECT MAX(MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS mem_stats WHERE (inner_cte.MEMORY_MB * 1.0 / mem_stats.max_memory_mb) > 0.75 ) SELECT s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata, COUNT(s2.migration_id) AS completed_migration_rows_over_75pct_max_mem FROM sq1 s1 LEFT JOIN sq2 s2 ON s2.DISPLAY_NAME = s1.DISPLAY_NAME GROUP BY s1.DISPLAY_NAME, s1.min_instance_id, s1.avg_memory_mb, s1.has_image_location_metadata ORDER BY s1.avg_memory_mb DESC;

question: For host "blaze8-12" and completed migrations, list each instance’s display name, hostname, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, UUID, migration status, and the maximum migration ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), along with the total number of completed migrations on that host and the average completed migrations per host; also include, for the same instances, the completed migration rows whose migration id is greater than the overall average migration id (within this host’s completed migrations), showing migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, network info, and the status-partitioned running average migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ic.NETWORK_INFO, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, instance_display_name, NETWORK_INFO, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE migration_id > (SELECT AVG(migration_id) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.migration_id, q2.migration_status, q2.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q2.DEST_COMPUTE, q2.instance_display_name, q2.NETWORK_INFO, q2.window_column FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.UUID = ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID FROM MIGRATIONS AS m WHERE m.ID = q2.migration_id ) ORDER BY q2.migration_id;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list each instance UUID and display name with the migration source and destination compute and status, the instance flavor JSON, the dense-rank value (partitioned by migration status) along with its average and deviation from that average, the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following migration rows ordered by migration ID, the instance project ID and that project’s total vCPUs across all non-deleted instances, and compute the ratio of project total vCPUs to the average dense-rank value.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id, SUM(i_all.vcpus) AS project_total_vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.uuid = inner_cte.uuid JOIN instances AS i_all ON i_all.project_id = i.project_id AND i_all.deleted = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id ORDER BY project_total_vcpus DESC, inner_cte.uuid ) SELECT q2.uuid AS instance_uuid, q2.display_name AS instance_display_name, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q1.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, q1.window_column AS dense_rank_value, q1.avg_window_column AS avg_dense_rank_value, q1.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS dense_rank_deviation_from_avg, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window_3_preceding_1_following, q2.project_id, q2.project_total_vcpus, ROUND(q2.project_total_vcpus / NULLIF(q1.avg_window_column, 0), 2) AS project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.status = q2.status AND q1.source_compute = q2.source_compute AND q1.dest_compute = q2.dest_compute AND q1.display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY project_vcpus_per_avg_dense_rank DESC, q2.project_total_vcpus DESC, q2.uuid;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12' that have a per-VM-state instance count greater than the overall average instances-per-state, list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory_mb, cached network_info JSON (and its 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of memory_mb by VM state), along with any matching completed migration details on the same host (migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance flavor JSON, the migration dense-rank value, the average dense-rank, and the deviation from that average). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH migration_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.status, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.display_name, ic.flavor, ic.window_column, ar.avg_window_column, (ic.window_column - ar.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_rank ar ), instance_details AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ) SELECT inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, state_counts.total_in_state, avg_state_counts.avg_instances_per_state FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT vm_state, COUNT(*) AS total_in_state FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS state_counts ON inner_cte.vm_state = state_counts.vm_state JOIN ( SELECT AVG(state_total) AS avg_instances_per_state FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS state_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY vm_state ) AS sub ) AS avg_state_counts ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb ) SELECT id.uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.network_info, id.window_column AS memory_mb_window_avg, id.total_in_state, id.avg_instances_per_state, md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.flavor, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, md.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank, md.deviation_from_avg_window_column AS migration_dense_rank_deviation FROM instance_details AS id JOIN migration_details AS md ON id.display_name = md.display_name WHERE id.total_in_state > id.avg_instances_per_state ORDER BY id.memory_mb;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are hosted on “blaze8-12”, show each migration’s ID and instance display name along with the instance memory (MB), the running sum of instance memory (MB) within the completed-status group ordered by migration ID, and the deviation of that running sum from the overall average running-sum value; additionally, for the same instances (non-deleted, in availability zone “flare3” on host “blaze8-12”), include the instance UUID, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows, the overall average memory benchmark, and the instance’s memory category (HIGH_MEMORY/LOW_MEMORY/AVERAGE_MEMORY). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each instance as 'HIGH_MEMORY' (at least 50% above the average), 'LOW_MEMORY' (at least 50% below the average), or 'AVERAGE_MEMORY'.
SQL: WITH migration_memory_analysis AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), avg_window AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_memory_mb, ic.window_column AS running_sum_instance_memory_mb, (ic.window_column - aw.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN avg_window aw ), instance_memory_benchmark AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), AverageMemory AS ( SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.max_instance_id_next_2, am.avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_avg_memory_mb, CASE WHEN ic.memory_mb > am.avg_memory_mb * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MEMORY' WHEN ic.memory_mb < am.avg_memory_mb * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MEMORY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MEMORY' END AS memory_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory am ) SELECT mma.migration_id, mma.instance_display_name, mma.instance_memory_mb, mma.running_sum_instance_memory_mb, mma.deviation_from_avg_running_sum_instance_memory_mb, imb.instance_uuid, imb.display_name, imb.vm_state, imb.power_state, imb.memory_mb, imb.vcpus, imb.instance_extra_id, imb.max_instance_id_next_2, imb.benchmark_avg_memory_mb, imb.memory_category FROM migration_memory_analysis mma JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = mma.instance_display_name JOIN instance_memory_benchmark imb ON imb.instance_uuid = i.UUID;

question: For instances hosted on “blaze8-12”, return the instance display name, the minimum instance ID, the average memory (MB), and the average memory utilization ratio (average memory divided by the maximum memory for that display name) for instances that are either in VM state “shelved_offloaded” or have at least 8 VCPUs and are in availability zone “flare3”; and, for the same display names, also include the completed migration details (instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, migration status) where the windowed minimum instance memory (over 3 preceding and 1 following migrations ordered by migration ID) is greater than the average of that windowed minimum across all such migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE (i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' OR i.VCPUS >= 8) AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, (inner_cte.avg_memory_mb * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) AS avg_memory_utilization_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.ID = inner_cte.min_instance_id JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_instance_id, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT uuid, display_name, source_compute, dest_compute, status, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.min_instance_id, q1.avg_memory_mb, q1.avg_memory_utilization_ratio, q2.uuid AS migration_instance_uuid, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS windowed_min_memory_mb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name;

question: For completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12', show each migration’s ID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), the running sum of instance memory (MB) within the completed-status group ordered by migration ID, and the completed-migration count for that display name—restricting results to instances whose memory is above the average memory for these migrations and whose display name is among the top 10 by completed-migration count on that host and also above the average completed-migration count per instance on that host. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, instance_memory_mb, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migration_id ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC ) SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.instance_display_name, q1.instance_memory_mb, q1.window_column AS running_instance_memory_mb_within_status, q2.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.display_name ORDER BY q2.migrations DESC, q1.migration_id;

question: For host "blaze8-12", which instances both (a) have a completed migration and (b) are in availability zone "flare3" with system metadata key "image_image_type" and a dense-rank (ordered by instance memory MB using the current row and 2 preceding rows) greater than the average dense-rank for that same host/zone set; and for those instances, list the instance display name, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance UUID, migration status, the maximum migration ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), the total number of completed migrations on that host, the average number of completed migrations per host across all hosts, the image_image_type metadata value, and the dense-rank value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.UUID, m.STATUS, MAX(m.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_migration_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.UUID, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.max_migration_id_next2, host_stats.completed_migrations_on_host, avg_stats.avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_host FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS host_stats ON host_stats.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN ( SELECT AVG(completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_host FROM ( SELECT i.host AS host, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.host ) AS sub ) AS avg_stats ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t1.HOST = 'blaze8-12' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.window_column * 1.0) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_value, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid WHERE inner_cte.window_column > (SELECT avg_window_column FROM avg_rank) ) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.HOSTNAME, q1.VM_STATE, q1.MEMORY_MB, q1.VCPUS, q1.UUID, q1.STATUS, q1.max_migration_id_next2, q1.completed_migrations_on_host, q1.avg_completed_migrations_per_host, q2.metadata_value AS image_image_type, q2.window_column AS dense_rank_memory_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_uuid = q1.UUID;

question: For instances on host 'blaze8-12' that have a completed migration, return only those whose migration destination compute appears more than once, and (among those) keep only instances whose vCPU count is greater than the average vCPU count of instances in the same availability zone on that host; show the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, instance UUID, the dense-rank-within-instance value, the destination compute, and the row number ordered by destination compute (with a 2-preceding/1-following window frame). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.STATUS, i.DEST_COMPUTE, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS dest_compute_cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) dc ON i.DEST_COMPUTE = dc.DEST_COMPUTE WHERE dc.dest_compute_cnt > 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneVcpuAverages AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i2.vcpus > (SELECT avg_vcpus FROM ZoneVcpuAverages WHERE ZoneVcpuAverages.availability_zone = i2.availability_zone) ) SELECT q2.display_name, q2.availability_zone, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.migration_type, q2.uuid AS instance_uuid, q2.window_column AS dense_rank_within_instance, q1.dest_compute, q1.window_column AS row_number_by_dest_compute FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.status = q2.status ORDER BY q2.availability_zone, q1.dest_compute, q2.display_name;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12” that also have completed migrations on the same host, list the instance hostname and UUID, instance extra ID, system metadata key/value, the running average instance memory (MB) by metadata key, whether the instance has any deleted system metadata, and the related migration details (migration id, source/destination compute, display name, running average migration id, total metadata rows, and average running-average migration id). Also compute a normalized ratio of average running-average migration id divided by the running-average instance memory, and sort by this ratio descending.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_rollup AS ( SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte ic JOIN instance_rollup ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.DELETED <> 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key ) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value = q2.metadata_value ORDER BY normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q1.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations on host 'blaze8-12', among instances whose migration destination compute appears more than once (from the row-numbered destination-compute results) and that also have vCPU counts above their availability zone’s average on that host, return each availability zone and the number of distinct instance UUIDs in it, keeping only availability zones with at least 2 such rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.STATUS, i.DEST_COMPUTE, i.window_column FROM inner_cte i JOIN ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS dest_compute_cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) dc ON i.DEST_COMPUTE = dc.DEST_COMPUTE WHERE dc.dest_compute_cnt > 1 ), q2 AS ( WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), ZoneVcpuAverages AS (SELECT i.availability_zone, AVG(i.vcpus * 1.0) AS avg_vcpus FROM instances AS i WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.availability_zone) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i2 ON i2.uuid = inner_cte.uuid WHERE i2.vcpus > (SELECT avg_vcpus FROM ZoneVcpuAverages WHERE ZoneVcpuAverages.availability_zone = i2.availability_zone) ) SELECT q2.availability_zone, COUNT(DISTINCT q2.uuid) AS Instance_Count FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.display_name = q2.display_name AND q1.status = q2.status WHERE q2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY q2.availability_zone HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY Instance_Count DESC;

question: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, what are the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining, and only return the result if the total migration memory remaining is greater than the average migration memory remaining across those same instances? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT min_instance_memory_mb, total_migration_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_memory_remaining > (SELECT AVG(m2.MEMORY_REMAINING) FROM INSTANCES i2 JOIN MIGRATIONS m2 ON i2.UUID = m2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m2.STATUS = 'completed');

question: For completed migrations, list the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory in MB, instance extra record id, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id, but only include rows where the instance memory is greater than the average instance memory across all completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.instance_memory_mb > ( SELECT AVG(inner_cte.instance_memory_mb * 1.0) FROM inner_cte );

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON. Then, for each migration status, include the total number of completed migrations and the number of distinct instances involved, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), status_summary AS ( SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT display_name) AS distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status ) SELECT i.status, i.source_compute, i.dest_compute, i.display_name, i.flavor, i.window_column, s.total_completed_migrations, s.distinct_instances_involved FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN status_summary AS s ON i.status = s.status;

question: For each instance VM state, show the minimum migration ID and the average instance memory (in MB) for migrations whose status is 'completed' and whose instance info cache record is not deleted (DELETED = 0), along with the overall average of these per-VM-state average memories across all VM states. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND c.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ) SELECT inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb, overall_avg.overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(avg_instance_memory_mb) AS overall_avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte ) AS overall_avg;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is ether-60, list the migration ID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance UUID, the instance display name, the instance VM state, and the cached network info (with row numbers within each migration status group ordered by migration ID), along with the total number of such migrations and the average number of such migrations per destination compute across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, c.NETWORK_INFO AS cached_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_HOST, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.cached_network_info, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(inner_cte.migration_id) OVER () AS total_confirmed_ether60_migrations, avg_by_dest.avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migrations_per_dest) AS avg_migrations_per_dest_compute FROM ( SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(*) AS migrations_per_dest FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE ) AS per_dest ) AS avg_by_dest ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For completed instance migrations involving instances in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the instance UUID, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, and the percentage of migration memory that has been processed (memory_processed divided by memory_total), keeping only rows where more than 75% of the migration memory has been processed. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio, inner_cte.completed_migrations_for_shelved_instances FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND (m.MEMORY_PROCESSED * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.MEMORY_TOTAL, 0)) > 0.75;

question: For each instance that has a completed migration, list the instance display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, and instance UUID, along with the percent of migration memory processed (memory_processed divided by memory_total) for migrations where the processed share is greater than 75%. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.migration_type, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.window_column, (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM inner_cte JOIN migrations AS m ON m.instance_uuid = inner_cte.uuid AND m.status = inner_cte.status AND m.migration_type = inner_cte.migration_type WHERE (m.memory_processed * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.memory_total, 0)) > 0.75;

question: For confirmed migrations, list the migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, instance display name, and instance network_info, along with the dense rank within each migration status ordered by that status; also include the overall average dense-rank value across these confirmed migrations and the deviation of each row’s dense rank from that average. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS ( SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte ) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte c CROSS JOIN avg_rank a;

question: For migrations that are in the status "completed" and whose related instance is in the "shelved_offloaded" VM state, return the minimum instance memory in MB and the total migration memory processed, but only if the total migration memory processed is greater than the average total migration memory processed across all migration/instance pairs. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT min_instance_memory_mb, total_migration_memory_processed FROM inner_cte WHERE total_migration_memory_processed > (SELECT AVG(m2.MEMORY_PROCESSED) FROM MIGRATIONS m2 JOIN INSTANCES i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID);

question: For migrations with status = 'completed', show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance display name, and the instance flavor JSON, along with a dense rank partitioned by the migration status and ordered by the migration status; also include, for each source compute, the total number of completed migrations from that source and the average number of completed migrations per source compute across all source computes. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations_from_source, avg_sources.avg_completed_migrations_per_source FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(source_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_source FROM ( SELECT source_compute, COUNT(*) AS source_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY source_compute ) AS sub ) AS avg_sources ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.window_column, avg_sources.avg_completed_migrations_per_source;

question: For instances that are in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state and have a migration with status “completed”, show the minimum instance memory (in MB) and the total migration memory remaining. Also include the count of distinct instances involved and the count of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) AS total_migration_memory_remaining FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_remaining, COUNT(DISTINCT i.UUID) AS distinct_instance_count, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON 1 = 1 JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_remaining;

question: For each destination compute host, find the destination compute name and the maximum of the per-migration window minimum instance memory (in MB), considering only migrations whose status is "completed". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed') SELECT DEST_COMPUTE, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_min_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For each availability zone, list the availability zone name, the total number of completed migrations for instances in that zone, and the average number of completed migrations per availability zone across all zones. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN ( SELECT AVG(migration_count) AS avg_migration_count FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS migration_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY availability_zone ) AS sub ) AS avg_migrations GROUP BY inner_cte.availability_zone, avg_migrations.avg_migration_count;

question: For confirmed migrations where the source compute is 'ether-60', show the migration ID, instance UUID, migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance VM state, and instance memory in MB (with row numbers within each migration status ordered by migration ID), and also include the instance’s project ID and a flag indicating whether that project has any other active (not completed/failed/error) non-deleted migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60' ) SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM migrations m2 JOIN instances i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND m2.status NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN instances i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id;

question: From the top 10 instance display names (for non-deleted instances) with the highest maximum completed-migration total memory, show the instance display name, migration status, the maximum MEMORY_TOTAL among completed migrations, the migration created timestamp, and whether the instance has any system metadata records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM instances i2 JOIN instance_system_metadata ism2 ON i2.uuid = ism2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i2.deleted = 0 AND ism2.deleted = 0 ) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_total DESC LIMIT 10;

question: For instance display names that have a number of completed migrations greater than the average completed-migration count across all instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata, list the display name and its completed migration count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT display_name, migrations FROM inner_cte WHERE migrations > (SELECT AVG(migrations) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY migrations DESC;

question: For the top 10 instance display names with the most completed migrations, show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the instance’s total memory (MB) and vCPU count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10 ) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations, MAX(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb, MAX(i.vcpus) AS vcpus FROM inner_cte JOIN instances AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.migrations ORDER BY inner_cte.migrations DESC;

question: For confirmed migrations where the destination compute is 'glint-94', show the migration id, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration status, instance UUID, instance display name, instance VM state, system metadata key and value, and the row number within each migration status (ordered by migration id). Also include, for each migration status, the total number of rows returned and the average migration id as a benchmark, and categorize each row as 'ABOVE_AVG_ID', 'BELOW_AVG_ID', or 'AT_AVG_ID' based on whether its migration id is above, below, or equal to that status benchmark. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.STATUS AS migration_status, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.DEST_COMPUTE = 'glint-94' ), StatusBenchmarks AS ( SELECT migration_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_in_status, AVG(migration_id) AS avg_migration_id_in_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY migration_status ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_HOST, ic.migration_status, ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.instance_vm_state, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, sb.total_rows_in_status, sb.avg_migration_id_in_status AS benchmark_avg_migration_id, CASE WHEN ic.migration_id > sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ID' WHEN ic.migration_id < sb.avg_migration_id_in_status THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ID' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ID' END AS id_vs_benchmark_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN StatusBenchmarks sb ON ic.migration_status = sb.migration_status;

question: For each migration source compute, considering only migrations with status equal to 'completed', show the source compute and the maximum value of the 3-preceding-and-1-following-row minimum instance memory (in MB) when ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT inner_cte.source_compute, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_window_min_memory_mb FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.source_compute;

question: For each instance VM state, among non-hidden and active migrations (i.e., migration status not in ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed')), return the VM state and the maximum (across migration statuses) of the per-status minimum total migration memory, considering only VM states that have at least 2 instances involved in such migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ) SELECT vm_state, MAX(min_memory_total) AS max_of_min_memory_total FROM inner_cte WHERE instance_count >= 2 GROUP BY vm_state;

question: For migrations with status = 'completed' and where the instance is on host 'blaze8-12', list the migration id, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, instance memory in MB, the instance system metadata key and value, and the average instance memory (in MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not repeat the migration status if it is the same as the previous row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(m.STATUS) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id) = m.STATUS THEN NULL ELSE m.STATUS END AS migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.SOURCE_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DEST_COMPUTE, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON m.ID = inner_cte.migration_id ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_id;

question: For confirmed migrations where the instance is on host "blaze8-12", show the migration status, source compute host, destination compute host, the instance display name, and the instance network_info, along with a dense rank within each migration status ordered by that status; also include the instance project_id and classify each row as 'HAS_PROJECT' when project_id is present or 'NO_PROJECT' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id, CASE WHEN i.project_id IS NOT NULL AND i.project_id <> '' THEN 'HAS_PROJECT' ELSE 'NO_PROJECT' END AS project_presence_category FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name;

question: For each instance host, considering only migrations with status equal to 'completed' where the instance host is 'blaze8-12', list the host and the maximum (across instances on that host) of the minimum memory remaining observed within each instance UUID (where the per-instance minimum is computed using the windowed minimum memory remaining partitioned and ordered by instance UUID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST;
