SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH migration_details AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), instance_details AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), host_summary AS ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT id.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM migration_details md CROSS JOIN instance_details id ) SELECT hs.completed_migration_count, hs.active_instance_count FROM host_summary hs ), HostActiveInstances AS ( SELECT i.host, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS active_instance_count FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host IS NOT NULL AND i.host <> '' GROUP BY i.host ), AverageHostInstances AS ( SELECT AVG(active_instance_count) AS avg_active_instances FROM HostActiveInstances ) SELECT 'blaze8-12' AS host, ic.completed_migration_count, ic.active_instance_count, ahi.avg_active_instances AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.active_instance_count > ahi.avg_active_instances * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN ic.active_instance_count < ahi.avg_active_instances * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic CROSS JOIN AverageHostInstances ahi;

question: For host 'blaze8-12', show each completed migration’s migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), VCPUs, and instance extra record id, along with (a) the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL within the same migration type and (b) for the same VM state and display name, the count of instances with more than 8 VCPUs on 'blaze8-12' and their minimum instance memory (MB); additionally, include the instance’s project_id and classify each row’s project as 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% more than the average completed-migration count per project on 'blaze8-12'), 'LOW_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH inner_cte AS ( WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), InstanceStateSummary AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(i.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VCPUS > 8 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.instance_uuid, md.migration_type, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.dest_host, md.display_name, md.vm_state, md.memory_mb, md.vcpus, md.instance_extra_id, md.memory_total, md.window_column AS min_memory_total_within_migration_type, iss.instance_count, iss.min_memory_mb FROM MigrationDetails md LEFT JOIN InstanceStateSummary iss ON md.vm_state = iss.vm_state AND md.display_name = iss.display_name ), ProjectMigrations AS ( SELECT i.project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_completed_migrations FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.project_id ), AverageProjectMigrations AS ( SELECT AVG(total_completed_migrations) AS avg_completed_migrations FROM ProjectMigrations ) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.migration_type, ic.source_compute, ic.dest_compute, ic.dest_host, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.memory_total, ic.min_memory_total_within_migration_type, ic.instance_count, ic.min_memory_mb, i.project_id, pm.total_completed_migrations, apm.avg_completed_migrations AS benchmark_completed_migrations, CASE WHEN pm.total_completed_migrations > apm.avg_completed_migrations * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' WHEN pm.total_completed_migrations < apm.avg_completed_migrations * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION' END AS project_utilization_category FROM inner_cte ic JOIN INSTANCES i ON ic.instance_uuid = i.uuid LEFT JOIN ProjectMigrations pm ON i.project_id = pm.project_id CROSS JOIN AverageProjectMigrations apm;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 display names by number of completed migrations (counting migrations by migration ID and only for instances with a non-empty key name), list the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID considering the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, the completed migrations count, and the completed-migrations-per-vCPU ratio rounded.
SQL: WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.key_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC;

question: For instances whose display names are in the top 10 by number of system metadata rows where the key is 'image_image_type' (considering only non-deleted instances), list all completed migrations for those instances and return the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, instance extra record id, migration memory total, the minimum migration memory total within each migration type (windowed by migration type), along with the instance’s metadata entry count and its total number of completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), TopMetadataInstances AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10), TotalCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, tmi.metadata_entries, tcm.completed_migration_count FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN TopMetadataInstances tmi ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tmi.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN TotalCompletedMigrations tcm ON cm.DISPLAY_NAME = tcm.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: From the top 10 instance display names with the most system metadata entries where the metadata key is 'image_image_type' and the instance is not deleted, show the completed migrations for those instances, including the migration ID, instance display name, instance availability zone, migration status, the migration’s rank within the 'completed' status group ordered by migration ID, and the instance’s metadata entry count. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH top_metadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_entries FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_entries DESC LIMIT 10 ), completed_migrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_availability_zone, cm.migration_status, cm.window_column, tm.metadata_entries FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN top_metadata tm ON tm.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name ORDER BY tm.metadata_entries DESC, cm.migration_id;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' that also have a migration with status equal to 'completed', show the instance UUID, system metadata key and value, instance power state, the running sum of instance IDs within each power-state group ordered by instance ID, the migration source and destination compute, the migration status, and the minimum instance memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstanceMetadata AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, ism.key AS metadata_key, ism.value AS metadata_value, i.power_state, SUM(i.id) OVER (PARTITION BY i.power_state ORDER BY i.id) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key, fim.metadata_value, fim.power_state, fim.window_column AS running_sum_instance_ids_within_power_state, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM ForgeInstanceMetadata fim JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.uuid = fim.instance_uuid WHERE cm.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY fim.instance_uuid, fim.metadata_key;

question: For instances in availability zone "flare3" that are in VM state "shelved_offloaded" and also have a migration with status "completed", show the instance UUID and display name, the migration status and the running sum of instance memory (MEMORY_MB) within each migration type ordered by instance memory, along with the instance ID, cached network info, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone ordered by instance ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, m.STATUS AS migration_status, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' ), ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS ( SELECT i.ID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' ) SELECT mcf.instance_uuid, mcf.instance_display_name, mcf.migration_status, mcf.window_column AS migration_type_memory_running_sum, soi.ID AS instance_id, soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.NETWORK_INFO, soi.window_column AS az_instance_id_rank FROM MigrationCompletedFlare3 AS mcf JOIN ShelvedOffloadedInstances AS soi ON soi.DISPLAY_NAME = mcf.instance_display_name WHERE soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' ORDER BY soi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, soi.ID, mcf.instance_uuid;

question: For the instance with UUID '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc' and for completed migrations on that same instance, list the instance details and each system metadata key/value along with the migration ID, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group, the minimum system metadata ID within each metadata key group, and the ratio (running sum of migration IDs divided by the minimum metadata ID) rounded to 2 decimals.
SQL: WITH MigrationMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT imd.instance_id, imd.display_name, imd.user_id, imd.project_id, imd.vm_state, imd.power_state, imd.memory_mb, imd.vcpus, imd.availability_zone, imd.metadata_key, imd.metadata_value, imd.metadata_id, imd.window_column AS min_metadata_id_in_key_group, mm.migration_id, mm.instance_display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, mm.window_column AS running_sum_migration_ids_in_key_group, ROUND(mm.window_column / NULLIF(imd.window_column, 0), 2) AS running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio FROM InstanceMetadataDetails imd JOIN MigrationMetadata mm ON mm.metadata_key = imd.metadata_key AND mm.instance_display_name = imd.display_name ORDER BY running_sum_to_min_metadata_id_ratio DESC, mm.migration_id;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a migration with status equal to 'completed', list the instance UUID, instance display name, availability zone, VM state, memory in MB, vCPU count, instance hostname, migration source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration type, memory total, memory processed, memory remaining, the minimum memory remaining within each instance UUID, the maximum system-metadata ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance UUID), and the memory processed ratio (memory processed divided by memory total) rounded.
SQL: WITH MigrationCompleted AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER ( ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT mc.instance_uuid, mc.instance_display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, mc.instance_hostname, mc.migration_source_compute, mc.migration_dest_compute, mc.migration_dest_host, mc.migration_type, mc.memory_total, mc.memory_processed, mc.memory_remaining, mc.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_per_instance_uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(mc.memory_processed / NULLIF(mc.memory_total, 0), 4) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM MigrationCompleted mc JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow imw ON imw.uuid = mc.instance_uuid ORDER BY memory_processed_ratio DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances where the maximum instance memory (grouped by instance display name, metadata key, and launched timestamp) is greater than 16000 MB, list the instance display name, metadata key, maximum memory in MB, and launched timestamp, along with any completed migration details for that instance (migration status, source compute, destination compute, the instance flavor JSON, and the dense-rank window column). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key, hmi.max_memory_mb, hmi.LAUNCHED_AT, cmwf.status AS migration_status, cmwf.source_compute, cmwf.dest_compute, cmwf.flavor AS instance_flavor_json, cmwf.window_column FROM HighMemoryInstancesByMetadata hmi JOIN CompletedMigrationsWithFlavor cmwf ON hmi.DISPLAY_NAME = cmwf.display_name ORDER BY hmi.max_memory_mb DESC, hmi.DISPLAY_NAME, hmi.metadata_key;

question: For instance display names that are among the top 10 by number of completed migrations (counting only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), show the instance display name, the number of completed migrations, and the total memory (in MB) for those display names whose instances are in the `shelved_offloaded` VM state and have total memory greater than 50000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) AS total_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.MEMORY_MB) > 50000) SELECT tcm.display_name, tcm.migrations AS completed_migrations, sohm.total_memory_mb FROM TopCompletedMigrations tcm JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemory sohm ON tcm.display_name = sohm.display_name ORDER BY tcm.migrations DESC;

question: For instances that are not deleted (deleted = 0) and that also have a completed migration (status = 'completed'), list the instance UUID, display name, memory (MB), vCPU count, and instance flavor JSON, along with the migration status, source compute, destination compute, and the instance system metadata key; also include the dense-rank values from the migration-by-instance window and the instance-by-project window. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ActiveInstancesWithFlavor AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_extra AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0), CombinedInstanceDetails AS ( SELECT ai.uuid AS instance_uuid, ai.display_name, ai.memory_mb, ai.vcpus, ai.flavor, cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.key AS system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ai.window_column AS project_dense_rank FROM ActiveInstancesWithFlavor ai JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON ai.display_name = cm.display_name ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, flavor, migration_status, source_compute, dest_compute, system_metadata_key, migration_dense_rank, project_dense_rank FROM CombinedInstanceDetails ORDER BY instance_uuid, system_metadata_key;

question: For completed migrations, show the migration ID, the (flare3) instance UUID and display name, the instance system metadata key and value, the row number over metadata key (with a frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row), and the running sum of instance IDs within each metadata key group for flare3 instances, matching records by instance display name and metadata key. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, SUM(i.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT c.migration_id, f.UUID AS instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.metadata_key, c.metadata_value, c.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, f.window_column AS flare3_instance_id_running_sum_window FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata c JOIN Flare3InstancesMetadataRunningSum f ON c.instance_display_name = f.DISPLAY_NAME AND c.metadata_key = f.KEY ORDER BY c.migration_id, c.metadata_key;

question: For instances in availability zone “flare3” that also appear in migrations with status “completed”, show the migration ID, instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory in MB, cached network_info JSON, the average memory_mb over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VM state and ordered by memory_mb), plus the instance system metadata key and value with a row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER ( PARTITION BY i.vm_state ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY i.memory_mb ), q2 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT q2.migration_id, q1.uuid AS instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS metadata_row_number_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.instance_display_name ORDER BY q2.migration_id, q1.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that had completed migrations with memory processed greater than 0, list the instance UUID, instance display name, availability zone, the dense rank when ordering by instance memory (in MB) using a window frame of the current row and the 2 preceding rows, the number of completed migrations for that instance, and the total memory processed (in bytes) across those migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeWindowRanks AS (SELECT i.uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY i.memory_mb ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge'), CompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone) SELECT cms.instance_uuid, cms.instance_display_name, cms.availability_zone, fwr.window_column AS dense_rank_by_memory_window, cms.completed_migration_count, cms.total_memory_processed FROM CompletedMigrationStats cms JOIN ForgeWindowRanks fwr ON cms.instance_uuid = fwr.uuid ORDER BY cms.completed_migration_count DESC, cms.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For non-deleted instances in availability zone “flare3” whose display name is among the top 10 instance display names with the highest number of completed migrations (considering only instances that have an `image_image_type` entry in instance system metadata), return the instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPUs, the instance extra record ID, the maximum instance ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by instance ID), and the completed migration count for that display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopMigrationInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), Flare3InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT fid.instance_uuid, fid.display_name, fid.vm_state, fid.power_state, fid.memory_mb, fid.vcpus, fid.instance_extra_id, fid.max_instance_id_next_2, tmi.migrations AS completed_migrations_for_display_name FROM Flare3InstanceDetails AS fid JOIN TopMigrationInstances AS tmi ON fid.display_name = tmi.display_name;

question: How many completed migrations are there for instances in availability zone 'flare3' that have a system metadata key of 'image_image_type'? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH instance_zone_metadata_rank AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.KEY = 'image_image_type' ), completed_migrations_memory AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type AS ( SELECT cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.instance_hostname, cmm.migration_source_compute, cmm.migration_dest_compute, cmm.migration_dest_host, cmm.migration_type, cmm.memory_total, cmm.memory_processed, cmm.memory_remaining, cmm.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid FROM completed_migrations_memory cmm JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.UUID = cmm.instance_uuid JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type;

question: For instances whose display name is 'forge' and that have at least 1 completed migration, show the instance UUID, hostname, VM state, memory in MB, the instance extra record ID, the minimum memory (in MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following rows ordered by the instance extra ID, along with the completed migration status, the instance flavor JSON from instance extra, the row number over instance display name (with a window frame of 2 preceding and 1 following row), and the total count of completed migrations for that instance. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ForgeInstancesWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' ), CompletedMigrationsWindow AS ( SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.FLAVOR AS instance_flavor_json, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS t0 JOIN INSTANCES t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' ), ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts AS ( SELECT m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, COUNT(*) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ) SELECT fiw.instance_uuid, fiw.hostname, fiw.vm_state, fiw.memory_mb, fiw.instance_extra_id, fiw.window_column AS forge_min_memory_mb_window, cmw.migration_status, cmw.instance_flavor_json, cmw.window_column AS completed_migrations_row_number_window, fcmc.completed_migration_count FROM ForgeInstancesWindow fiw JOIN ForgeCompletedMigrationCounts fcmc ON fcmc.instance_uuid = fiw.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsWindow cmw ON cmw.instance_display_name = 'forge' WHERE fcmc.completed_migration_count >= 1 ORDER BY fiw.instance_extra_id;

question: For instances with a completed migration, list the instance UUID, display name, migration status, destination compute host, and the rank within the 'completed' status group, but only for display names whose total summed root disk size across instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type' is greater than 50 GB (also show that total root disk size). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, SUM(i.ROOT_GB) AS total_root_gb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING SUM(i.ROOT_GB) > 50 ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, m.STATUS, m.DEST_COMPUTE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN MIGRATIONS AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT subq2.UUID, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME, subq1.total_root_gb, subq2.STATUS, subq2.DEST_COMPUTE, subq2.window_column FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.DISPLAY_NAME = subq1.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY subq1.total_root_gb DESC, subq2.window_column ASC;

question: For each instance availability zone and VM state, considering only instances that are not deleted, show the availability zone and VM state, the total number of instances and the earliest instance creation time (using the instance UUID links to include both the instance extra record and the instance network info cache), along with the number of distinct instances that have a completed migration and the average of the migration window minimum instance memory (in MB) for those completed migrations. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceZoneStateStats AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE), CompletedMigrationWindow AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), CompletedMigrationZoneState AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmw.uuid) AS completed_migration_instance_count, AVG(cmw.window_column) AS avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationWindow cmw JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ins.UUID = cmw.uuid WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, izss.VM_STATE, izss.instance_count, izss.earliest_created_at, cmzs.completed_migration_instance_count, cmzs.avg_window_min_memory_mb FROM InstanceZoneStateStats izss JOIN CompletedMigrationZoneState cmzs ON izss.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmzs.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND izss.VM_STATE = cmzs.VM_STATE ORDER BY izss.instance_count DESC;

question: For instances named 'forge' that also have completed migrations while in the 'shelved_offloaded' VM state, list the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), hostname, VM state, instance extra record ID, the system metadata key and value, and both windowed minimum memory values (one ordered by migration ID and one ordered by instance extra ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedShelvedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( ORDER BY ie.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT csm.status AS migration_status, csm.source_compute, csm.dest_compute, csm.instance_uuid, csm.display_name, csm.memory_mb, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.instance_extra_id, csm.key AS system_metadata_key, csm.value AS system_metadata_value, csm.window_column AS migration_window_min_memory_mb, fi.window_column AS instance_extra_window_min_memory_mb FROM CompletedShelvedMigrations csm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON csm.instance_uuid = fi.instance_uuid ORDER BY csm.instance_uuid, fi.instance_extra_id;

question: For completed migrations of instances in the “shelved_offloaded” VM state, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance UUID, instance display name, instance memory (MB), system metadata key and value, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID; also include (for the same migration status and VM state, considering only instances that have system metadata with key 'image_image_type') the number of migrations and the minimum instance memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH ShelvedCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, ism.key, ism.value, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ), MigrationStatusVmStateStats AS ( SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state ) SELECT scm.status, scm.source_compute, scm.dest_compute, scm.instance_uuid, scm.display_name, scm.memory_mb, scm.key, scm.value, scm.window_column, msvs.migration_count, msvs.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ShelvedCompletedMigrations scm JOIN MigrationStatusVmStateStats msvs ON msvs.migration_status = scm.status AND msvs.instance_vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded';

question: For migrations with status equal to "completed", list the migration id, migration status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, migration instance UUID, the instance display name, instance VM state, instance memory (MB), instance vCPUs, the system metadata key and value for that instance, and the minimum migration memory remaining within each destination compute group (ordered by destination compute), but only for instances whose display name is among those where the total memory (in MB) across “shelved_offloaded” instances with at least one system metadata entry keyed “image_image_type” exceeds 20000 MB; also include that total memory per display name. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), high_memory_shelved_display_names AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.dest_host, cm.instance_uuid, cm.instance_display_name, cm.instance_vm_state, cm.instance_memory_mb, cm.instance_vcpus, cm.metadata_key, cm.metadata_value, cm.migration_memory_remaining, cm.window_column, hmsdn.total_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations cm JOIN high_memory_shelved_display_names hmsdn ON cm.instance_display_name = hmsdn.display_name ORDER BY cm.dest_compute;

question: List instance UUID, display name, VM state, power state, memory (MB), vCPU count, system metadata key/value, and the windowed max INSTANCE_EXTRA ID (current row through next 2 by instance UUID) for non-deleted instances with non-deleted system metadata, and also include (as separate UNION ALL rows) any matching instances that have at least one completed migration where the maximum migration MEMORY_TOTAL is greater than 0, showing that max MEMORY_TOTAL and the instance creation timestamp along with a reason indicating which condition produced each row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationMaxMemory AS ( SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, i.created_at FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' GROUP BY i.display_name, i.created_at, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0 ), ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER ( ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 ), CombinedInstanceReport AS ( SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, cmm.max_memory_total, cmm.created_at AS instance_created_at, 'Has Completed Migration Max Memory' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim JOIN CompletedMigrationMaxMemory cmm ON aim.display_name = cmm.display_name UNION ALL SELECT aim.instance_uuid, aim.display_name, aim.vm_state, aim.power_state, aim.memory_mb, aim.vcpus, aim.metadata_key, aim.metadata_value, aim.max_instance_extra_id_next_2, NULL AS max_memory_total, NULL AS instance_created_at, 'Active Instance Metadata Window' AS reason FROM ActiveInstanceMetadataWindow aim ) SELECT instance_uuid, display_name, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, max_instance_extra_id_next_2, max_memory_total, instance_created_at, reason FROM CombinedInstanceReport ORDER BY display_name, instance_uuid, metadata_key;

question: For completed migrations, show each migration’s id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, and instance VM state, along with (1) the maximum instance memory (MB) over the window ordered by migration id from the current row through the next 2 rows, and (2) the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over the window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT mwmm.migration_id, mwmm.status, mwmm.source_compute, mwmm.dest_compute, mwmm.dest_host, mwmm.display_name, mwmm.vm_state, mwmm.max_memory_mb_next_2, mmwam.memory_mb, mmwam.metadata_key, mmwam.metadata_value, mmwam.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_status_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM MigrationWindowMaxMemory AS mwmm JOIN MigrationMetadataWindowAvgMemory AS mmwam ON mwmm.migration_id = mmwam.migration_id ORDER BY mwmm.migration_id, mmwam.metadata_key;

question: For completed migrations, list the migration ID, instance display name, the instance’s availability zone and VM state, the number of non-deleted instances in that availability zone and VM state (only keeping groups with at least 2 instances), the earliest creation time in that group, and the instance system metadata key/value with the row number ordered by the metadata key using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ism.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceCountsByAZAndState AS (SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE) SELECT cmim.migration_id, cmim.instance_display_name, icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, icb.VM_STATE, icb.instance_count, icb.earliest_created_at, cmim.metadata_key, cmim.metadata_value, cmim.window_column FROM CompletedMigrationInstanceMetadata cmim JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cmim.instance_display_name JOIN InstanceCountsByAZAndState icb ON icb.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AND icb.VM_STATE = i.VM_STATE WHERE icb.instance_count >= 2 ORDER BY icb.instance_count DESC, cmim.migration_id, cmim.metadata_key;

question: For each VM state and availability zone, considering only instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type' and only migrations with status = 'completed', return the VM state, availability zone, total instance count, minimum instance memory (MB), and completed migration count for those instances, but only for state/zone groups where completed migrations account for more than 75% of the instances. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStateAZStats AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ), CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ), CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(m.ID) AS completed_migration_count FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT isaz.VM_STATE, isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, isaz.instance_count, isaz.min_memory_mb, cmc.completed_migration_count FROM InstanceStateAZStats isaz JOIN CompletedMigrationCountsByStateAZ cmc ON isaz.VM_STATE = cmc.VM_STATE AND isaz.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = cmc.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE (cmc.completed_migration_count * 1.0 / isaz.instance_count) > 0.75;

question: For each completed migration whose instance is not deleted, list the migration id, instance UUID, migration type, source compute, destination compute, destination host, the instance display name/VM state/memory (MB)/vCPUs and instance extra record id from the migration details, along with the minimum migration MEMORY_TOTAL within each migration type, and also include the instance power state plus the windowed maximum INSTANCE_EXTRA id over the current and next 2 instances when ordered by instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.power_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, MAX(ie.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0) SELECT cmd.migration_id, cmd.INSTANCE_UUID, cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE, cmd.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_COMPUTE, cmd.DEST_HOST, cmd.DISPLAY_NAME AS migration_instance_display_name, cmd.VM_STATE AS migration_instance_vm_state, cmd.MEMORY_MB AS migration_instance_memory_mb, cmd.VCPUS AS migration_instance_vcpus, cmd.instance_extra_id AS migration_instance_extra_id, cmd.MEMORY_TOTAL, cmd.window_column AS min_memory_total_within_migration_type, nis.power_state AS nondeleted_instance_power_state, nis.max_instance_extra_id_next2 FROM CompletedMigrationDetails cmd JOIN NonDeletedInstanceWindowStats nis ON cmd.INSTANCE_UUID = nis.uuid ORDER BY cmd.MIGRATION_TYPE, cmd.migration_id;

question: For each completed migration, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, destination host, instance display name, instance VM state, the maximum instance memory (MB) over the current migration and the next 2 migrations (ordered by migration id), along with the instance memory (MB), system metadata key/value, and the average instance memory (MB) over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following migrations (partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER (ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ), q2 AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.migration_id, q1.status, q1.source_compute, q1.dest_compute, q1.dest_host, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.max_memory_mb_next_2, q2.memory_mb, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_2_pre_2_fol FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_id = q2.migration_id ORDER BY q1.migration_id;

question: For completed migrations, return the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, and instance system metadata key (with a dense rank per instance UUID), and also include the matching "forge" instance details (instance UUID, hostname, availability zone, cached network_info JSON, and the instance’s rank within its availability zone). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed'), ForgeInstances AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS t0 JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name, cm.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_per_instance_uuid, fi.UUID AS instance_uuid, fi.HOSTNAME, fi.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fi.NETWORK_INFO, fi.window_column AS instance_rank_within_availability_zone FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN ForgeInstances fi ON fi.UUID = ( SELECT i2.uuid FROM instances i2 WHERE i2.display_name = cm.display_name LIMIT 1 );

question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, and whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames AS (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > 20000) SELECT cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MIN(cmwm.window_column) AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT sohdn.display_name) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Shelved_Offloaded_High_Memory_DisplayName FROM CompletedMigrationsWithMetadata cmwm LEFT JOIN ShelvedOffloadedHighMemoryDisplayNames sohdn ON cmwm.instance_display_name = sohdn.display_name GROUP BY cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY completed_migration_count DESC, cmwm.DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For non-deleted instances that also have a completed migration, list the instance ID, UUID, user ID, project ID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPUs, and instance info cache record ID, along with (1) the maximum instance ID over the current row and the next 2 rows when ordered by instance ID, and (2) the migration source compute, destination compute, migration status, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM instances AS i JOIN instance_info_caches AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 ), q2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.status, MIN(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' ) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.display_name, q1.vm_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.info_cache_id, q1.max_instance_id_next_2, q2.source_compute, q2.dest_compute, q2.status AS migration_status, q2.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_uuid = q2.uuid ORDER BY q1.instance_id;

question: For instances with display name 'forge' that also have migrations with status 'completed', return the migration ID, instance display name, system metadata key, the running sum of migration IDs within each metadata key group (ordered by migration ID), along with the instance UUID, system metadata value, instance extra created_at timestamp, and the row number over metadata keys (using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.KEY AS metadata_key, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, t0.CREATED_AT AS extra_created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t2.KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), CompletedMigrationsForForge AS ( SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.instance_display_name, cm.metadata_key, cm.window_column AS completed_migrations_running_sum, fime.instance_uuid, fime.metadata_value, fime.extra_created_at, fime.window_column AS forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrations cm JOIN INSTANCES i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.instance_display_name JOIN ForgeInstanceMetadataExtra fime ON fime.instance_uuid = i.UUID AND fime.metadata_key = cm.metadata_key ) SELECT migration_id, instance_display_name, metadata_key, completed_migrations_running_sum, instance_uuid, metadata_value, extra_created_at, forge_metadata_row_number FROM CompletedMigrationsForForge;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are on host 'blaze8-12' (and with non-deleted instance info cache records), which migration types have at least 2 such migrations, and for each of those migration types return the migration type, the total count of completed migrations, and the minimum MEMORY_TOTAL value within that migration type. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MigrationRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, MIN(md.window_column) AS Min_Memory_Total_Within_Migration_Type FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN MigrationRanks mr ON md.migration_id = mr.migration_id GROUP BY md.MIGRATION_TYPE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT md.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC, md.MIGRATION_TYPE;

question: For instances on host “blaze8-12” (and not deleted, in availability zone “flare3”), group by the system metadata key and show: the number of completed migrations on “blaze8-12”, the average of the per-key instance-memory window average (2 preceding to 2 following rows), and the maximum “next 2 migrations” max-memory window value from the completed-migration records. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationWindow AS (SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT imw.metadata_key, COUNT(DISTINCT mw.migration_id) AS completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12, AVG(imw.window_column) AS avg_instance_memory_window_by_key, MAX(mw.max_memory_mb_next_2) AS max_of_migration_next2_memory_window FROM MigrationWindow mw JOIN instances i ON i.display_name = mw.display_name AND i.vm_state = mw.vm_state AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow imw ON imw.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY imw.metadata_key ORDER BY completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12 DESC, imw.metadata_key;

question: For each non-deleted instance in availability zone “flare3” running on host “blaze8-12” that also has a completed migration on that same host, show the instance UUID, display name, and network_info cache, along with the number of linked instance_extra records and total memory (MB), plus the completed migration’s ID, source compute, destination compute, and the migration’s rank within the “completed” status group (ordered by migration ID). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceExtraStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info, COUNT(ie.id) AS extra_record_count, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM instances i JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, iic.network_info), CompletedMigrationsOnHost AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ic.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT ies.instance_uuid, ies.display_name, ies.network_info, ies.extra_record_count, ies.total_memory_mb, cm.migration_id, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.window_column AS migration_rank_within_completed_status FROM InstanceExtraStats ies JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = ies.instance_uuid JOIN CompletedMigrationsOnHost cm ON cm.migration_id = m.id ORDER BY ies.instance_uuid, cm.migration_id;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that had completed migrations with positive memory processed, show each instance’s UUID, display name, and availability zone, along with its completed migration count and total memory processed (bytes), plus (for that same display name on blaze8-12 among non-deleted instances that have system metadata key 'image_image_type') the minimum instance ID and the average memory (MB). Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migrations_per_instance AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), instance_memory_stats_by_display_name AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT c.instance_uuid, c.instance_display_name, c.availability_zone, c.completed_migration_count, c.total_memory_processed, s.min_instance_id, s.avg_memory_mb FROM completed_migrations_per_instance c JOIN instance_memory_stats_by_display_name s ON c.instance_display_name = s.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY c.completed_migration_count DESC, c.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For destination compute hosts that have at least 2 completed migrations for instances on host "ether-18", list the destination compute, the number of those completed migrations, and whether there is any completed migration to the same destination compute for an instance on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations AS (SELECT t0.DISPLAY_NAME, t1.STATUS, t1.DEST_COMPUTE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.DEST_COMPUTE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES t0 JOIN MIGRATIONS t1 ON t0.UUID = t1.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.STATUS = 'completed' AND t0.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS instance_vcpus, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS m JOIN INSTANCES i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE, COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) AS Ether_Completed_Migration_Count, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT bcm.DISPLAY_NAME) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Blaze8_12_Completed_Migration_To_Same_Dest_Compute FROM EtherCompletedMigrationsWithMetadata ecmwm LEFT JOIN BlazeCompletedInstanceMigrations bcm ON ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE = bcm.DEST_COMPUTE GROUP BY ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ecmwm.migration_id) >= 2 ORDER BY Ether_Completed_Migration_Count DESC, ecmwm.DEST_COMPUTE;

question: For instances on host "blaze8-12" in availability zone "flare3" that also have a completed migration, show the instance UUID, display name, VM state, memory (MB), vCPU count, key name, and instance_extra ID, along with the minimum memory_mb within each vCPU group and the migration’s availability zone, status, type, and dense-rank within each instance UUID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.KEY_NAME, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT subq2.UUID AS instance_uuid, subq2.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, subq2.VM_STATE, subq2.MEMORY_MB, subq2.VCPUS, subq2.KEY_NAME, subq2.instance_extra_id, subq2.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_vcpu_group, subq1.availability_zone AS migration_availability_zone, subq1.status AS migration_status, subq1.migration_type, subq1.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_instance_uuid FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.UUID = subq1.uuid ORDER BY subq2.UUID, subq1.window_column;

question: For instances in availability zone 'flare3' running on host 'blaze8-12' that have a completed migration, show the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, migration status, migration type, the dense rank of migrations within each instance UUID, plus the instance key name, metadata entry count, and total vCPUs summed across its system metadata rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, m.status, m.migration_type, i.uuid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.uuid ORDER BY i.uuid) AS window_column FROM instances AS i JOIN migrations AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12'), InstanceMetadataStats AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM instances i JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.key_name) SELECT md.uuid AS instance_uuid, md.display_name, md.availability_zone, md.status AS migration_status, md.migration_type, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, ims.key_name, ims.metadata_entry_count, ims.total_vcpus FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMetadataStats ims ON md.uuid = ims.instance_uuid WHERE md.availability_zone = 'flare3' ORDER BY md.display_name, md.uuid;

question: For instances hosted on blaze8-12 that have instance system metadata key 'image_image_type' (and are not deleted where applicable), list each instance display name along with its completed-migration count (for the top 10 by completed migrations), its minimum instance ID, and its average memory (MB), and include a reason indicating whether the row comes from the “Top 10 by completed migrations” list or from the overall “has image_image_type system metadata on blaze8-12 (not deleted)” set. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH InstanceStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), TopMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), CombinedInstanceView AS ( SELECT tm.display_name, tm.migrations, is1.min_instance_id, is1.avg_memory_mb, 'Top 10 by completed migrations' AS reason FROM TopMigrations tm LEFT JOIN InstanceStats is1 ON tm.display_name = is1.display_name UNION ALL SELECT is2.display_name, NULL AS migrations, is2.min_instance_id, is2.avg_memory_mb, 'Has image_image_type system metadata on blaze8-12 (not deleted)' AS reason FROM InstanceStats is2 ) SELECT display_name, migrations, min_instance_id, avg_memory_mb, reason FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY display_name, reason;

question: For completed migrations whose instance host is 'prime3-77', show (by migration status) the migration status, the total number of completed migrations, the total number of instances with system metadata in availability zone 'flare3' on host 'blaze8-12', the average of the running average instance memory (MB), and the maximum migration rank within the status group. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationStatusRanks AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77'), InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.KEY) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT msr.migration_status, COUNT(DISTINCT msr.migration_id) AS total_completed_migrations, COUNT(DISTINCT imam.instance_uuid) AS total_instances_with_metadata, AVG(imam.window_column) AS avg_running_avg_instance_memory_mb, MAX(msr.window_column) AS max_migration_rank_within_status FROM MigrationStatusRanks AS msr CROSS JOIN InstanceMetadataMemoryAvgs AS imam GROUP BY msr.migration_status ORDER BY total_completed_migrations DESC;

question: For completed migrations whose instances are hosted on 'blaze8-12', list each migration’s id, instance UUID, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, system metadata key/value, and the per-instance-UUID running average of migration id; also include (when available for that same instance display name on 'blaze8-12' with non-deleted instances and system metadata key 'image_image_type') the minimum instance id and average memory (MB), ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ), CombinedResults AS ( SELECT md.migration_id, md.INSTANCE_UUID, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, md.metadata_key, md.metadata_value, md.window_column, ims.min_instance_id, ims.avg_memory_mb FROM MigrationDetails md LEFT JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON md.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id;

question: For host blaze8-12, find instances that both (1) have a completed migration and (2) have system metadata key image_image_type. For those instances, return the instance UUID, display name, hostname, migration source/destination compute and destination host, migration type, memory total/processed/remaining, the minimum memory remaining within each instance UUID, plus the image_image_type metadata value, cached network info, and the row number over metadata values (with a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row). Do not return any rounded answers.
