SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_hostname, md.migration_source_compute, md.migration_dest_compute, md.migration_dest_host, md.migration_type, md.memory_total, md.memory_processed, md.memory_remaining, md.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value, imn.NETWORK_INFO, imn.window_column AS metadata_value_row_number_window FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork imn ON md.instance_display_name = imn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value;

question: For completed migrations, combine the results for instances on host 'prime3-77' and instances on host 'blaze8-12' by returning (for each pair of rows) the prime migration id, prime instance display name, prime availability zone, migration status, and the rank of the prime migration within its status group, along with the blaze migration’s source compute, destination compute, destination host, blaze instance display name, blaze instance memory in MB, and the blaze windowed average memory in MB (2 preceding and 2 following rows) partitioned by migration status and ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH PrimeCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS instance_availability_zone, m.STATUS AS migration_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'prime3-77' ), BlazeCompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ) SELECT pcm.migration_id, pcm.instance_display_name AS prime_instance_display_name, pcm.instance_availability_zone AS prime_instance_availability_zone, pcm.migration_status, pcm.window_column AS prime_status_rank, bcm.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS blaze_source_compute, bcm.DEST_COMPUTE AS blaze_dest_compute, bcm.DEST_HOST AS blaze_dest_host, bcm.DISPLAY_NAME AS blaze_instance_display_name, bcm.MEMORY_MB AS blaze_instance_memory_mb, bcm.window_column AS blaze_avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol FROM PrimeCompletedMigrations pcm CROSS JOIN BlazeCompletedMigrations bcm ORDER BY pcm.migration_id, bcm.migration_id;

question: For each instance display name and system metadata key on host blaze8-12 (considering only non-deleted instances whose maximum memory per group is greater than 16000 MB), list the maximum instance memory (MB) and launched timestamp, along with the number of completed migrations for that same instance/metadata key, the maximum running sum of migration IDs within the metadata key group, and the ratio of that maximum running sum to the maximum memory.
SQL: WITH MaxInstanceMemory AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism JOIN INSTANCES i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, ism.KEY, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000 ), CompletedMigrations AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT mim.DISPLAY_NAME, mim.metadata_key, mim.max_memory_mb, mim.LAUNCHED_AT, COUNT(cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, MAX(cm.window_column) AS max_migration_id_running_sum, ROUND(MAX(cm.window_column) / NULLIF(mim.max_memory_mb, 0), 6) AS running_sum_per_mb FROM MaxInstanceMemory mim LEFT JOIN CompletedMigrations cm ON cm.instance_display_name = mim.DISPLAY_NAME AND cm.metadata_key = mim.metadata_key GROUP BY mim.DISPLAY_NAME, mim.metadata_key, mim.max_memory_mb, mim.LAUNCHED_AT ORDER BY running_sum_per_mb DESC;

question: For the host blaze8-12 and instances that have system metadata key image_image_type, list the top 10 instance display names by number of completed migrations, and for those instances also show the instance UUID, the metadata key and value, the cached network info, and the 2-preceding/2-following windowed average of instance memory (MB) partitioned by the metadata value and ordered by instance created-at. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH TopMigratedInstances AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS migrations FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND ism.key = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY migrations DESC LIMIT 10), InstanceMetadataNetworkWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT tmi.display_name, tmi.migrations, imnw.instance_uuid, imnw.metadata_key, imnw.metadata_value, imnw.network_info, imnw.window_column FROM TopMigratedInstances tmi JOIN InstanceMetadataNetworkWindow imnw ON tmi.display_name = imnw.instance_display_name ORDER BY tmi.migrations DESC, imnw.instance_uuid;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have non-deleted system metadata with key image_image_type and also had completed migrations with positive memory processed, show the instance UUID, display name, availability zone, completed migration count, total memory processed (bytes), and the dense-rank window value computed by ordering instances by memory (MB) using the current row and the 2 preceding rows. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH subq1 AS ( SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, dense_rank() OVER ( ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.DELETED = 0 AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ), subq2 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ) SELECT subq2.instance_uuid, subq2.instance_display_name, subq2.availability_zone, subq2.completed_migration_count, subq2.total_memory_processed, subq1.window_column AS memory_dense_rank_window FROM subq2 JOIN subq1 ON subq2.instance_uuid = subq1.instance_uuid ORDER BY subq2.total_memory_processed DESC;

question: For completed migrations where the instance is hosted on blaze8-12, show the migration id, status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the minimum instance ID and average instance memory (MB) for that display name among instances in availability zone flare3 with system metadata KEY = image_image_type (also hosted on blaze8-12), along with the instance memory (MB), instance network_info, and the minimum instance memory (MB) over a window of 3 preceding and 1 following row ordered by migration id. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), InstanceMemoryStats AS ( SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(i.ID) AS min_instance_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb FROM INSTANCES i JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ) SELECT md.migration_id, md.migration_status, md.SOURCE_COMPUTE, md.DEST_COMPUTE, md.instance_display_name, ims.min_instance_id, ims.avg_memory_mb, md.instance_memory_mb, md.NETWORK_INFO, md.window_column FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN InstanceMemoryStats ims ON md.instance_display_name = ims.DISPLAY_NAME;

question: For each image_image_type metadata value on host blaze8-12, show the metadata value, the number of distinct instances that also had at least one completed migration with positive memory processed, the average and maximum completed-migration count per instance, the total memory processed (in bytes) across those instances’ completed migrations, and the average of the 2-preceding/2-following windowed instance memory (in MB) for that metadata value. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH CompletedMigrationsPerInstance AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name AS instance_display_name, i.availability_zone AS availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM migrations m JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_extra ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND m.memory_processed > 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ) SELECT im.metadata_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cm.instance_uuid) AS instances_with_completed_migrations, AVG(cm.completed_migration_count) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_instance, MAX(cm.completed_migration_count) AS max_completed_migrations_per_instance, SUM(cm.total_memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed_bytes, AVG(im.window_column) AS avg_window_memory_mb FROM CompletedMigrationsPerInstance cm JOIN ImageTypeMetadataWithWindowMem im ON cm.instance_uuid = im.instance_uuid GROUP BY im.metadata_value ORDER BY instances_with_completed_migrations DESC;

question: For each VM state and availability zone on host 'prime-35' (restricted to instances that have a system metadata entry with key = 'image_image_type'), and for each active (non-hidden) migration status for that same VM state, list the VM state, availability zone, migration status, the instance count on 'prime-35', the instance count involved in active migrations, the minimum instance memory (MB), the minimum migration total memory, and the ratio (rounded) of minimum migration total memory to minimum instance memory.
SQL: WITH ActiveMigrationsByState AS ( SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM INSTANCES i JOIN MIGRATIONS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 AND m.STATUS NOT IN ('accepted', 'confirmed', 'reverted', 'error', 'failed', 'completed') GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS ), HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ AS ( SELECT ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.MEMORY_MB) AS min_memory_mb FROM INSTANCE_EXTRA ie JOIN INSTANCES ins ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA ism ON ins.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.VM_STATE, ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ) SELECT h.VM_STATE, h.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, a.migration_status, h.instance_count AS prime35_instance_count, a.instance_count AS active_migration_instance_count, h.min_memory_mb, a.min_memory_total, ROUND(a.min_memory_total / NULLIF(h.min_memory_mb, 0), 2) AS Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio FROM HostPrime35InstancesByStateAZ h JOIN ActiveMigrationsByState a ON h.VM_STATE = a.vm_state ORDER BY Min_MigrationMemory_to_Min_InstanceMemory_Ratio DESC;

question: For migrations with status = "completed" whose instance is on host "blaze8-12", list migration details and include a reason showing whether the row comes from (1) the 2-preceding/2-following window average of instance memory (MB) by migration status ordered by migration id, or (2) the running sum of migration IDs within each instance system metadata key group ordered by migration ID. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MemoryWindow AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.MEMORY_MB, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER ( PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID ), MetadataRunningSum AS ( SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM MIGRATIONS AS m JOIN INSTANCES AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ), CombinedMigrations AS ( SELECT mw.migration_id, mw.SOURCE_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_COMPUTE, mw.DEST_HOST, mw.DISPLAY_NAME, mw.MEMORY_MB, mw.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window, NULL AS metadata_key, NULL AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Memory Window Avg' AS reason FROM MemoryWindow mw UNION ALL SELECT mrs.migration_id, NULL AS SOURCE_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_COMPUTE, NULL AS DEST_HOST, mrs.instance_display_name AS DISPLAY_NAME, NULL AS MEMORY_MB, NULL AS avg_memory_mb_window, mrs.metadata_key, mrs.window_column AS running_sum_migration_id_by_key, 'Metadata Key Running Sum' AS reason FROM MetadataRunningSum mrs ) SELECT migration_id, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, DISPLAY_NAME, MEMORY_MB, avg_memory_mb_window, metadata_key, running_sum_migration_id_by_key, reason FROM CombinedMigrations ORDER BY migration_id, reason;

question: On host "prime-35", for each instance (UUID, display name, and availability zone) that has completed migrations, show its migration count and total memory processed, and also include (for the same availability zone) the VM state breakdown with the number of non-deleted instances and the earliest instance creation time. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH q1 AS ( SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, SUM(m.memory_processed) AS total_memory_processed FROM instances i JOIN migrations m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone ), q2 AS ( SELECT ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE, COUNT(ins.UUID) AS instance_count, MIN(ins.CREATED_AT) AS earliest_created_at FROM INSTANCES AS ins JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = ins.UUID WHERE ins.DELETED = 0 AND ins.HOST = 'prime-35' GROUP BY ins.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, ins.VM_STATE ) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.availability_zone, q2.vm_state, q2.instance_count, q2.earliest_created_at, q1.migration_count, q1.total_memory_processed FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.availability_zone = q2.availability_zone ORDER BY q1.total_memory_processed DESC, q1.migration_count DESC, q1.instance_uuid;

question: How many completed migrations are associated with instances running on host "blaze8-12", and how many instances in availability zone "flare3" are running on host "blaze8-12"? Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH completed_migrations_on_blaze AS ( SELECT m.id AS migration_id, m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, m.dest_host, i.display_name, i.vm_state, MAX(i.memory_mb) OVER ( ORDER BY m.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS max_memory_mb_next_2 FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_info_caches AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), flare3_instances_metadata AS ( SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.KEY AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.KEY ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM INSTANCES AS i JOIN INSTANCE_EXTRA AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.migration_id) AS completed_migration_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fim.instance_uuid) AS flare3_instance_count FROM completed_migrations_on_blaze cm CROSS JOIN flare3_instances_metadata fim;

question: For instances on host blaze8-12 that have completed migrations and also have system metadata key image_image_type, show the migration status, source compute, destination compute, instance display name, the instance system metadata key, the image_image_type metadata value, and cached network info, along with the migration dense rank and the image-type row number. Do not return any rounded answers.
SQL: WITH MigrationDetails AS ( SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ism.key, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.instance_uuid ORDER BY m.instance_uuid) AS window_column FROM migrations AS m JOIN instances AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN instance_system_metadata AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' ), ImageTypeMetadata AS ( SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS window_column FROM INSTANCE_SYSTEM_METADATA AS t0 JOIN INSTANCES AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN INSTANCE_INFO_CACHES AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.KEY = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12' ) SELECT md.status AS migration_status, md.source_compute, md.dest_compute, md.display_name, md.key AS instance_system_metadata_key, itm.metadata_value, itm.network_info, md.window_column AS migration_dense_rank, itm.window_column AS image_type_row_number FROM MigrationDetails md JOIN ImageTypeMetadata itm ON md.display_name = itm.display_name ORDER BY md.display_name, itm.metadata_value;
